Description:
**Req Id:**
433116
  
  
Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.
  
  
We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.
  
  
On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.
  
  
At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.
  
  
**Summary**
Bell's AI Fabric program is a transformational initiative focused on delivering scalable, mission-critical data centre infrastructure. The Program Controls Manager will establish and maintain the governance processes that connect departments, projects, and stakeholders across the program. Reporting to the Director, Program Controls, the role will provide leadership across interface and handover management, risk governance, root cause analysis, lessons learned, continuous improvement, action management, and change control coordination. The role will help maintain a reliable, integrated view of program risks, dependencies, actions, and improvement initiatives to support predictable delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Interface & Handover Management
  
  

* Own and administer the program Handover & Interdependency Tracker.
* Coordinate cross-functional reviews across Land Development, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, Operational Readiness, Physical Security, IT, Data Centre Operations, and Legal or Regulatory stakeholders.
* Monitor critical interfaces, dependencies, entry criteria, exit criteria, and handover requirements across project phases.
* Identify and escalate at-risk dependencies, blocked gates, unclear ownership, and overdue deliverables.
* Facilitate recurring interface reviews and maintain clear action, decision, and escalation records.

Risk Management & Root Cause Analysis
  
  

* Maintain the integrated program RAID register and associated governance cadence.
* Coordinate risk reviews with risk owners and support clear articulation of cause, event, impact, mitigation, and contingency.
* Track mitigation and corrective actions through to verified closure.
* Lead or facilitate Root Cause Analysis for significant issues, recurring problems, schedule impacts, cost impacts, and control failures.
* Analyze risk and issue trends and recommend preventive or corrective actions.

Lessons Learned & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain a structured lessons learned framework across the program.
* Capture lessons at key gates and milestones, not only at project closeout.
* Ensure relevant lessons are translated into updated standards, procedures, checklists, and delivery requirements for future phases and sites.
* Facilitate post-milestone reviews and cross-functional improvement workshops.
* Monitor recurring issues and identify opportunities to improve delivery maturity and control effectiveness.

Feedback Loop & Action Management
  
  

* Establish and maintain closed-loop action tracking across governance forums.
* Ensure actions, decisions, risks, and improvement initiatives have clear owners, due dates, and closure evidence.
* Drive accountability through regular follow-up, escalation, and reporting.
* Provide leadership with visibility into overdue commitments, systemic blockers, and decisions required.

Change Management Governance
  
  

* Coordinate the Change Control Board process on behalf of Program Controls.
* Coordinate integrated change reviews across scope, cost, schedule, risk, design, construction, commissioning, and operations stakeholders.
* Ensure approved and pending changes are cross-referenced with affected risks, interfaces, handover gates, and program baselines.
* Monitor implementation of approved changes and associated actions.
* Maintain auditable change records, decision logs, and governance reporting.

Program Reporting & Governance Support
  
  

* Develop concise executive dashboards and governance materials covering risks, interfaces, actions, changes, and continuous improvement.
* Support monthly program reporting and leadership review cycles.
* Provide analytical insights on trends, recurring issues, dependencies, and emerging areas of concern.
* Support the Director, Program Controls in launching, implementing, and embedding new program controls processes, procedures, tools, and governance routines across the program.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of program controls procedures, standards, templates, and governance routines.
* Act as an integrator and gatekeeper for program controls information while ensuring functional owners remain accountable for validation and delivery.

**Critical Qualifications**

* Progressive experience in program controls, project controls, PMO, risk management, program governance, continuous improvement, or major capital project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, cross-functional programs or projects involving multiple internal teams, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Strong understanding of risk, issue, action, change, interface, and governance management practices.
* Experience facilitating Root Cause Analysis and driving corrective actions to closure.
* Ability to connect schedule, cost, risk, change, and handover information into an integrated program view.
* Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to communicate complex information clearly and prepare concise executive-level reporting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools and familiarity with project controls and reporting systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting the delivery of data centre, mission-critical, telecommunications, or hyperscale infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data centre lifecycle phases, including planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.
* Knowledge of mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls, network, and security environments.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint, or similar project controls platforms.
* PMP, PMI-RMP, PSP, CCP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent professional certification.

**Additional Requirements**

* Cross-functional leadership and influence without direct authority.
* Structured problem solving and sound judgment.
* Ownership, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to challenge constructively and escalate with clarity.
* Executive communication and data-driven storytelling.
* Continuous improvement mindset and commitment to organizational learning.

Description:
**Description**
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.
  
  
You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.
  
  
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?
  
  
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.
  
  
Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Delivery
  
  

* Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training, and support teams to seek to understand our customers’ needs, their business, how success is defined, and ensure that we are exceeding expectations in developing and delivering customer outcomes.
* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, project milestones, budgets and defining success criteria.
* Manage engagement goals and lead teams to achieve customers’ business outcomes by managing issues, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
* Work with stakeholders and AWS sales teams to amend the contractual scope, financials, and expected timelines
* Ability to take ownership, work under pressure, stay within budget, and meet deadlines
* Hold internal and external teams accountable, redirect when needed, and manage customer expectations throughout engagements.
* Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and able to take proactive steps to ensure teams meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Ability to be self-directed and effective working independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment
* Results-oriented, prioritizes work activities, plans and stays organized in order to meet commitments.
* Ensures AWS and Partner teams meet or exceed customer business objectives

Solutions
  
  

* Lead individuals, teams, or multiple groups and play an active role in analyzing project goals, creating a plan to achieve those goals, and then guiding AWS team members, customer stakeholders/SMEs and potentially other third parties to achieve those goals while understanding the client environment and any limitations to execution.
* Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness.
* Ability to apply strategic thinking and demonstrate understanding of requirements to execute.
* Ability to make decisions guided by policies, procedures and business plans with limited guidance.
* Ability to apply business and financial acumen to achieve measurable business results for customer success.
* Support and influence the sales lifecycle by engaging clients in defining next phases of cloud projects as appropriate to meet client needs.
* Participate in practice development by contributing to the development of practical solutions and methodologies, and the development of knowledge sharing artifacts.

Communication
  
  

* Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills with team members and audiences of all levels.
* Ability to build relationships with various customer and internal AWS stakeholders which consists of senior leadership teams (C-level execs, SVP/VP, Directors) and project level resources such as SMEs.
* Plans and oversees the preparation and distribution of project communications.
* Understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed. Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
* Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Team Work
  
  

* Proven success in working with teams and executive leadership in a complex customer environment.
* Team player who effectively integrates, motivates and builds relationships with cross-functional team members (local or remote), sponsors, key stakeholders, executives, and other individuals or organizations involved with or affected by the project.
* Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent people management skills, including the ability to influence, negotiate and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.

This is a customer-facing role. You may be required to travel to customer locations to deliver professional services when needed when travel resumes. We offer a flexible work environment to help you balance your work and personal life, while still remaining customer obsessed.
  
  
Livraison
  
  

* Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients.
* Planifier, organiser et gérer toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets afin d'assurer une livraison réussie. Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
* Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
* Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
* Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
* Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
* Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
* Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
* Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.
* S'assurer que les équipes d'AWS et des partenaires atteignent ou dépassent les objectifs d'affaires des clients.

Solutions
  
  

* Diriger des individus, des équipes ou plusieurs groupes et jouer un rôle actif dans l'analyse des objectifs de projet, la création d'un plan pour atteindre ces objectifs, puis guider les membres de l'équipe AWS, les intervenants/experts en la matière du client et potentiellement d'autres tiers pour atteindre ces objectifs, tout en comprenant l'environnement du client et les contraintes liées à l'exécution.
* Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
* Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.
* Capacité à prendre des décisions guidées par les politiques, les procédures et les plans d'affaires avec un encadrement limité.
* Capacité à appliquer un sens des affaires et des finances pour obtenir des résultats d'affaires mesurables favorisant le succès des clients.
* Soutenir et influencer le cycle de vente en mobilisant les clients dans la définition des prochaines phases des projets infonuagiques, selon les besoins des clients.
* Participer au développement de la pratique en contribuant à l'élaboration de solutions et de méthodologies concrètes, ainsi qu'au développement d'outils de partage des connaissances.

Communication
  
  

* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation avec les membres de l'équipe et les auditoires de tous les niveaux.
* Capacité à établir des relations avec divers intervenants internes d'AWS et clients, y compris les équipes de haute direction (cadres de niveau C, PVP principal/VP, directeurs) ainsi que les ressources au niveau des projets telles que les experts en la matière.
* Planifier et superviser la préparation et la distribution des communications de projet.
* Comprendre les styles de fonctionnement des autres ainsi que les relations d'équipe/client, la dynamique d'équipe, et adapter son comportement en conséquence pour réussir. Reconnaître les nuances environnementales ou culturelles et s'adapter.
* Favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié.

Travail d'équipe
  
  

* Succès démontré dans le travail avec des équipes et la haute direction dans un environnement client complexe.
* Esprit d'équipe qui intègre efficacement, motive et établit des relations avec les membres d'équipes interfonctionnelles (locaux ou à distance), les commanditaires, les intervenants clés, les cadres et les autres personnes ou organisations touchées par le projet.
* Expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement matriciel, gérant de multiples intervenants.
* Excellentes compétences en gestion des personnes, y compris la capacité d'influencer, de négocier et d'obtenir des résultats par l'entremise d'autres personnes qui ne sont pas des subordonnés directs.

At Bell Media, you’ll redefine digital connections and pioneer next-generation services, propelling us to reach new heights, unlock untapped potential and expand horizons for our customers.

  

**Summary**
-----------

The Head of Digital and Agency is a senior, strategic, and results-driven leadership role responsible for driving Bell Media’s agency partnerships and spearheading our digital go-to-market strategy. This role combines executive agency relationship management with deep digital and programmatic expertise to accelerate Bell Media’s revenue growth.

As the chief architect of our digital sales story, you will elevate our programmatic capabilities (video, display, and audio) into a robust, data-driven go-to-market proposition. You will serve as the primary point of contact for a priority media agency holding company in Canada, leveraging executive relationships to establish Bell Media as the premier partner for innovative, full-funnel digital advertising solutions.

------------------------

Digital Go-to-Market & Acceleration

* Drive Digital Revenue: Lead and exceed programmatic and digital revenue targets across video, display, and audio streams, contributing to the overall digital growth of Bell Media.
* Elevate the Data Story: Synthesize complex data-driven insights and audience measurement tools into a compelling, market-facing narrative that demonstrates the value of Bell Media's owned and operated properties.
* Expand Programmatic Footprint: Drive spend growth through programmatic buying structures (including Preferred Deals and Private Marketplaces), capturing incremental revenue over and above direct, contractual relationships.
* Accelerate Innovation: Identify and develop high-impact, programmatic, and ad-tech opportunities that pioneer next-generation campaign structures while leading a team of high performing programmatic experts.

Agency Partnerships & Commercial Leadership

* Manage Senior Relationships: Cultivate and manage executive-level relationships across a global agency holding company in Canada.
* Joint Business Planning: Lead joint business planning, commercial negotiations, and high-value upfront deal structures.
* Scaled Education & Thought Leadership: Design and deliver comprehensive training programs, workshops, and thought leadership sessions to inspire agency partners to become experts on Bell Media's digital platforms, measurement tools, and creative capabilities.
* Co-Create Campaigns: Collaborate with agency partners to co-create breakthrough, multi-platform campaigns utilizing platform-specific creative capabilities.

Cross-Functional Advocacy & Product Alignment

* Internal Client Advocate: Act as the voice of the client internally, working closely with Direct Sales, product, monetization, and go to market operations teams to optimize deal delivery and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Influence Product Roadmap: Partner with internal product, marketing, engineering, and measurement teams to feed agency and market requirements directly into Bell Media's digital product development cycle.
* Activity Reporting: Systematically monitor, analyze, and report weekly on sales pipelines, market activities, campaign performance metrics, and final revenue outcomes.

**Critical Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Media, Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: 6–10 years of progressive experience in digital media sales, agency partnerships, or digital ad-tech management (ideally working for a major publisher, agency holding company, DSP, or trading desk).
* Ad Ecosystem Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of the programmatic ad ecosystem, ad-tech platforms, inventory waterfalls, and digital monetization strategies.
* Market Relationships: Proven track record of managing senior relationships within the Canadian media agency landscape and securing major commercial deals.
* Data Literacy: Superior ability to analyze market trends and complex data sets, translating technical insights into actionable, revenue-generating client strategies.
* Communication & Leadership: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to inspire teams and collaborate effectively.

* Deep familiarity with retail media networks, programmatic audio, and full-funnel digital strategy.
* Strong background in creative innovation, campaign planning, and audience measurement.

Title: Senior Cost Program Manager, AMER Data Center Planning and Delivery, AMER Pre-Construction Team
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Data Centers are industry-leading examples of innovation in the areas of security, safety, space utilization, efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are the global team responsible for the construction of Amazon-owned sites. Our teams are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers, and are known for changing the face of cloud computing.  
  
As a Senior Cost Program Manager, you will own the programmatic cost data programs that underpin pre-construction budgets across multiple data center campuses in AMER, including budget development, cost forecasting, and benchmarking. You will build and run the standards, benchmarks, databases, and tools that turn current market pricing into trusted, decision-ready budgets. You will lead ground-up Operating Plan (OP) cost development for Pre-Construction projects, a plan with direct visibility to senior leadership, and support Capital Appropriation Requests (CAR) with budgets that reflect current commercial costs. You will own cost indexation and forecasting, and partner with Finance, Cost Control, Procurement, and senior leaders to improve budget accuracy and cost predictability at scale. You will work closely with Preconstruction, Construction, Cost Control, Real Estate, Design Engineering, Due Diligence, and Procurement teams, as well as external general contractors. This role demands a proactive program leader with exceptional organizational skills, a deep understanding of construction costs, and the ability to manage competing priorities and ambiguous problems in a fast-paced environment.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own budget benchmarking and data accuracy for a multi-billion-dollar data center construction portfolio across AMER, defining and continuously improving benchmarking standards and ensuring benchmark data stays within established, globally approved parameters.  
  
Lead ground-up Operating Plan (OP) cost development for Pre-Construction projects and support Capital Appropriation Requests (CAR), providing the benchmarks, unit-rate data, and validation that give leadership confidence in funding decisions.  
  
Own cost indexation and forecasting, building and maintaining a cost indexation database and forecasting future cost impacts across AMER markets and geographies based on macroeconomic trends for medium- and long-term planning.  
  
Build and own the cost benchmarking database, tools, and models, standing up a new benchmarking database and maintaining budget-development tools that incorporate current market pricing, bid data, and design changes.  
  
Own and continuously refine the project-level estimating and budget-development tools used by Pre-Construction, keeping them current with recent pricing, design standards, and lessons learned.  
  
Define Pre-Construction cost data and benchmarking standards, including how cost data is captured, validated, and standardized by building type and attributes across campuses.  
  
Develop unit-rate intelligence and cost benchmarks by analyzing commercial pricing at trade and major-category levels to understand cost drivers and inform budget development.  
  
Track value engineering and cost avoidance, capturing, quantifying, and reporting opportunities and outcomes, and feeding insights back into benchmarks and budget tools.  
  
Partner with Finance, Cost Control, Procurement, Preconstruction, Construction, Real Estate, Design Engineering, and Due Diligence teams, as well as external partners, to interpret cost trends across markets and geographies.  
  
Lead complex, cross-functional cost initiatives and continuous-improvement programs, assessing cost impacts, aligning stakeholders to strategic goals, and delivering measurable improvements in budget accuracy through influence rather than direct authority.  
  
Define and own cost KPI reporting, establishing key cost and benchmarking metrics and delivering regular reporting through dashboards and a defined cadence to stakeholders, Finance, and senior leadership.  
  
Be available to travel up to 20% of the time to support project and program needs.  
  
About the team  
AMER Pre-Construction within the AMER DCPD org are a nationwide team of diverse set of building and construction experts who excel at constructing the innovative infrastructure that keeps the cloud running and growing. We engage with a wide range of internal partner teams from the outset of new site pursuits through to construction. Daily, we think creatively and act boldly to continuously improve our deliveries. We focus on Bias for Action and Insist on the Highest Standards to Deliver Results and Earn Trust with our stakeholders and customers.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
* 7+ years of construction, cost management, or project/program management experience.
* Experience leading cross-functional programs or initiatives, including defining standards and driving them to adoption.
* Experience building cost databases, benchmarking frameworks, or budget-development tools at a portfolio or program level.
* Proficiency with cost estimating tools and databases (e.g., RSMeans, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, or equivalent) and the ability to interpret drawings and specifications across all disciplines (MEP, civil, structural, architectural)
* Experience building and managing cost data, cost models, or benchmarking for ground-up mission critical construction projects.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing and presenting business-case analyses or budgets to senior leadership, including driving continuous-improvement practices.
* Experience with capital planning cycles, Cost Breakdown Structure evaluation, and Capital Budget Request cost inputs at portfolio scale
* Experience with construction project management and cost tools such as Procore, Primavera, or Sage, and with SQL or relational databases.
* Experience developing cost benchmarks or budgets with limited information using historical data and commercial pricing analysis.
* Direct experience in the construction of data centers, critical infrastructure, or large-scale commercial projects.
* Experience using AI/LLM tools or data visualization platforms to build models, dashboards, and reporting.

Description:

-------------------------

The Client Business Executive is accountable for the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster. The role owns the business agenda across pre-sales, solution positioning, sales execution, delivery alignment, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Own the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, and overall business results.
* Act as the primary CSS business interface toward Cluster Heads, Customer Unit leadership, KAMs, and relevant Solution Area leaders.

* Lead the CSS business agenda across the full lifecycle, from early customer engagement and opportunity shaping through pre-sales, contracting, delivery, adoption, value realization, renewal, upsell, and cross-sell.

* Lead the development of customer engagement plans, growth plans, account strategies, and opportunity execution plans in collaboration with KAMs and cross-functional teams.
* Ensure high-quality proposals, solution positioning, commercial models, costing, pricing, governance, and executive communications throughout the sales cycle.
* Establish strong alignment between sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, delivery, service management, commercial management, finance, partners, and customer stakeholders.
* Maintain accountability for delivery readiness and customer value realization, ensuring that commitments made during the sales process are understood, managed, and delivered effectively.
* Act as a senior escalation point for significant customer, commercial, delivery, quality, and relationship issues within the CSS scope.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, standardized ways of working, performance transparency, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with partners and internal organizations to strengthen the end-to-end CSS offering and expand the value delivered to customers.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* Significant experience in telecommunications, IT, managed services, customer support, service operations, or related technology businesses.
* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of CSS offerings, service management, operational transformation, automation, digitalization, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead business growth, manage senior customer relationships, and deliver commercial results in a complex matrix organization.
* Experience managing or influencing large, geographically distributed, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including understanding of revenue, margin, cost, forecasting, pricing, investment, and risk management.
* Ability to engage credibly with C-level and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to make sound, timely decisions across competing business, customer, delivery, and commercial priorities.
* Strong executive presence, resilience, adaptability, and results orientation.
* A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create alignment across organizational boundaries.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Success will be measured by the Client Business Executive’s ability to:

* Deliver sustainable and profitable CSS growth.
* Strengthen executive-level customer relationships and customer confidence.
* Improve alignment between pre-sales, sales, delivery, and service operations.
* Increase pipeline quality, conversion, retention, upsell, and cross-sell performance.

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.  
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $ 150.000USD - $ 190.000 USD.* *We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.*

Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Title: Head of Operations Canada
Description:
At elockers, we are on a mission to make live events smarter, easier and more enjoyable.

From world-class festivals and stadiums to iconic concert venues, we provide innovative self-service locker solutions that give visitors the freedom to enjoy unforgettable experiences without worrying about their belongings.

We work with some of the biggest names in live entertainment, including Live Nation, AEG, The Bowery Presents, Goldenvoice and Knockdown Center.

Founded in the Netherlands, elockers is rapidly expanding across Europe and North America. We are an ambitious, entrepreneurial company with big plans, strong partnerships and a passion for the live entertainment industry.

***Lock in. Own the operation.***

You take ownership of our operations and key client relationships across Canada. Based in Toronto, you keep our existing venues and festivals running smoothly while building the operational structure for what comes next. This is a hands-on leadership role. Title: Manager Operations FCC - Mutual Funds

This position plays a key role in maintaining strong relationships with internal business partners, clients, vendors, and industry participants to ensure Mutual Fund operations remain efficient, scalable, and aligned with evolving business and regulatory requirements.

**Nice to have:**

  + Knowledge of Broadridge's Dataphile platform an asset.

**Some of the ways we’ll help you feel valued and supported as part of our team:**

  

* Flexible working arrangements that vary based on role requirements

* Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
* Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer-paid premiums, that include up to $6000 annually for mental health services and therapy

Title: Manager Technology, Application Support
Description:
**It’s not a package. It’s a promise®.**
As Canada’s leading integrated freight, package, and logistics provider, we’ve been helping promises get where they need to be for more than 60 years. How does the magic happen?

**Description**
Purolator relies on a broad portfolio of production applications to support employees, customers, terminals, transportation, and business operations. We are seeking a technology manager to lead the team accountable for application support, reliability, lifecycle management, and enhancements across these services.
  
  
This role will strengthen the operating model for production support by ensuring that projects, support queues, knowledge, monitoring, incidents, vulnerabilities, maintenance, and improvement work are managed with discipline. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership with technical judgement to deliver on new functionality and projects, improve service health, reduce repeat issues, and make support work visible and sustainable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop application support employees, contractors, and vendor resources across onshore and offshore locations.
* Own service health and support outcomes for assigned production applications, including availability, performance, security, supportability, and lifecycle risk.
* Establish clear queue ownership, triage standards, priorities, service targets, escalation paths, and workload reporting across incidents, requests, problems, defects, and enhancements.
* Ensure knowledge base articles, runbooks, support procedures, dependency maps, recovery steps, and escalation contacts are accurate, current, usable, and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Drive strong incident and problem management practices, including major incident leadership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and prevention of repeat failures.
* Embed SRE practices such as service-level indicators and objectives, actionable monitoring, alert quality, capacity planning, error budgets, automation, resilience testing, and toil reduction.
* Partner with development teams to improve production readiness, operational acceptance, handoffs, release quality, deployment safety, and early-life support.
* Plan and deliver small enhancements, defect corrections, automation, maintenance, and technical-debt work without compromising operational support.
* Own application security hygiene, including vulnerability intake, CVE assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, exception tracking, and executive reporting.
* Maintain lifecycle and technical-risk registers covering unsupported components, aging platforms, expiring certificates, capacity concerns, critical dependencies, and recovery gaps.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira, dashboards, and other systems of record to provide accurate visibility into work, aging, service performance, backlog health, and risk.
* Partner with Service Desk, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Product, Development, and business teams to resolve issues and improve end-to-end service ownership.
* Manage vendor service levels, statements of work, deliverables, escalations, invoices, budgets, contracts, and resource plans.
* Monitor and report AWS consumption, forecasts, optimization opportunities, and financial risks for supported applications.
* Set team goals, complete performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support career development and succession planning.
* Provide concise reporting to the Director on service health, incidents, backlog, reliability, vulnerabilities, financials, people, risks, and decisions required.

**Additional Responsibilities**
Leadership expectations
  
  
You will create clarity, set measurable expectations, coach with candour, and build an inclusive team culture. You will balance delivery speed with security, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability, while providing the Director with timely visibility into outcomes, risks, dependencies, capacity, vendor performance, and financials.
  
  
Operating model focus
  
  

* Clear ownership from intake through resolution, prevention, and knowledge capture
* Reliable queues, service targets, escalation paths, and stakeholder communications
* Measurable service health using logs, metrics, traces, synthetic checks, dashboards, and business signals
* Disciplined vulnerability, patch, certificate, dependency, and application lifecycle management
* A balanced backlog across incidents, defects, small enhancements, automation, reliability, security, and technical debt

**Education**

* Post-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SRE, ITIL, DevOps, cloud, cybersecurity, architecture, or agile delivery certification are assets.

**Experience**

* Progressive experience in application support, production operations, software engineering, SRE, DevOps, or service management, including several years leading technical teams.
* Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and common failure modes.
* Demonstrated success improving incident, problem, change, knowledge, monitoring, and vulnerability-management practices.
* Experience managing operational queues, support metrics, service targets, backlogs, small enhancements, and technical-debt priorities.
* Ability to use data to identify service trends, explain risk, prioritize investments, and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Experience managing mixed employee, contractor, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* Strong financial, vendor, stakeholder, and executive-reporting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a calm and structured approach during incidents and escalations.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, mobile, customer-facing, or 24x7 operational applications.
* Hands-on exposure to AWS, observability platforms, ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, and automated testing.
* Experience transitioning services from project delivery into stable production ownership.

Proficiency in English is required for this position due to the frequent communications that must be conducted in English with various stakeholders. This requirement is justified by the nature of the responsibilities and operational needs.

Title: Head of IT Security
Description:

* Overall security posture of the Group's technology estate, measured against an agreed target maturity (e.g. NIST CSF / ISO 27001 controls)

* Minimum 3 years leading an IT security or cybersecurity team, including SOC or security operations
* Proven track record in financial services (insurance, banking, payments or fintech) or another regulated industry

* Experience leading ISO 27001 and / or PCI DSS compliance and regulatory or external audits
* Experience managing managed-security providers and international technology vendors • GCC / Qatar regulatory exposure (QCB, NCSA) is a strong plus; insurance industry experience is an advantage

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Description:
Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.

**Key competencies**

* Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership
* Calm, structured coordination during incidents and escalations
* Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
* Influence and negotiation without direct authority
* Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Single point of contact:** Serve as the primary interface with Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security issues, requests and dependencies.
* **Incident and escalation coordination:** Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths.
* **Change and dependency coordination:** Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels.
* **Security and access requests**: Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion.
* **Engagement model:** Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities.
* **Governance and reporting:** Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
* Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
* Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
* Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
* Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries

**Key Technical Skills**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management.
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles.
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices.
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments.
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable.

Title: Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.
  
  
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.
  
  
If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
‎
  
  
The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. The role establishes the monitoring, operational controls and support practices needed to run AI services effectively in production and provides visibility into agent and model behavior, platform performance and emerging operational risks. The role works closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance and technology teams to ensure AI platforms operate within established enterprise standards and guardrails.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications across Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio or AI are considered assets.

* Experienced in managing a budget of up to $15M for business unit, demonstrated financial acumen with experience in annual budget creation, quarterly forecasting, and management of accruals and invoicing

**Senior Security Manager, Assistance**

* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.

* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.

* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.

Title: Senior Manager, IT Operations

Headquartered in Toronto, the Canada Infrastructure Bank (CIB) is responsible for investing in new infrastructure projects. The CIB’s mission is to work with provincial, territorial, municipal, federal, Indigenous and private sector investor partners to transform the way infrastructure is planned, financed and delivered in Canada.

The Senior Manager, IT Operations, is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the CIB’s IT function. Reporting to the VP, IT, this role ensures reliable service delivery, effective vendor and managed service partner performance, disciplined ITSM practices, and strong operational controls across infrastructure, service desk, cybersecurity operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity. The role manages approximately two internal team members and works closely with business stakeholders, application management, project delivery teams, and external partners.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Lead day-to-day IT operations, including service desk, infrastructure, incident management, cybersecurity operations, and managed service partner delivery
* Develop, maintain, and improve ITSM processes, procedures, and operating standards that support reliable, secure, and efficient technology services
* Define, monitor, and report on service-level objectives, operational metrics, risks, and recurring issues
* Manage IT operating expenses, vendor performance, contracts, renewals, and service improvement plans within approved budgets
* Support the ongoing development and execution of the IT roadmap by identifying operational improvements, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements
* Maintain and improve cybersecurity controls and operational security practices, including oversight of vulnerability management, penetration testing, awareness training, and remediation tracking
* Maintain the IT Disaster Recovery Plan and lead regular business continuity and disaster recovery exercises to validate plans, procedures, and readiness
* Support internal and external audit activities by providing evidence, coordinating responses, and tracking remediation actions
* Develop and deliver clear IT communications, end-user guidance, and organization-wide training where required
* Work with Application Management and Project Management teams to ensure technology initiatives are operationally ready, delivered to specification, and transitioned effectively into support
* Occasional travel to CIB offices in Calgary and Montréal may be required

**Your ideal profile:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, service delivery, or related technology roles
* Experience leading IT operations in a structured, risk-conscious environment, preferably in financial services, investments, asset management, or a comparable sector
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM practices, service desk operations, incident management, Azure administration, Microsoft 365, networking, and cloud-first or hybrid environments
* 5+ years of cybersecurity-related experience; CISSP, CISM, or equivalent certification is an asset
* Experience managing vendors, managed service providers, budgets, contracts, service levels, and operational performance
* Experience supporting audits, risk management, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational control activities
* Experience working in a growing or transforming organization, including process improvement, technology change, or operational maturity initiatives
* Project delivery experience; PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is an asset
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Dynamics 365 Business Central, Artificial Intelligence, or Machine Learning is an asset
* Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential or sensitive matters

Ensure operational readiness, availability, performance, resilience, scalability, and security across engineering technology environments. Establish platform standards, technical governance frameworks, service operating procedures, lifecycle plans, and modernization initiatives.
* Advance virtual desktop infrastructure and engineering computing: Own the strategy and roadmap for engineering VDI and remote computing environments. Partner with Infrastructure teams to optimize performance, user experience, graphics acceleration, and engineering workloads. Define standards for engineering workstations, cloud workstations, and hybrid delivery models, while evaluating future engineering computing technologies and deployment approaches.
* Govern demand delivery and resources: Oversee the intake, prioritization, and delivery of engineering technology initiatives. Manage resource allocation, team capacity planning, and delivery priorities. Partner with CDS Front Door, PMO, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to execute platform initiatives successfully, while monitoring delivery performance, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
* Strengthen data governance and information lifecycle management: Define governance and lifecycle management practices for engineering application data. Establish strategies for retention, archiving, recovery, compliance, business continuity, and long-term accessibility. Govern vendor-hosted and WSP cloud-hosted application environments, collaborating with Data Governance, Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to meet corporate standards and support analytics, AI, and digital delivery initiatives.
* Accelerate future-ready technology and innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, cloud services, AI-enabled engineering platforms, and automation opportunities. Develop technology roadmaps supporting evolving engineering delivery models. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, scalability, sustainability, and user experience, and lead proof-of-concepts, innovation pilots, and technology modernization programs.
* Lead platform governance and cross-functional delivery: Partner with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and Operations teams to ensure platform alignment. Define technical standards, change management practices, and operational governance processes. Ensure engineering platform changes are tested, documented, and operationally supported, while providing leadership for complex technical escalations and enterprise-wide platform initiatives.
* Own financial management and executive leadership: Manage platform budgets, forecasts, investment planning, and optimization initiatives. Develop business cases and technology investment recommendations, drive cost optimization across cloud, infrastructure, hosting, and operational services, and deliver executive reporting, dashboards, presentations, and governance updates.
* Build the global operating model and team: Lead and develop a global team of platform and engineering technology specialists. Design and implement scalable delivery and support models. Drive workforce planning, capability development, upskilling, and succession planning. Establish governance and engagement models for business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams, fostering accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**The Skills That Set You Apart**

* Education and enterprise platform leadership: A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, combined with significant experience managing enterprise platforms, infrastructure services, cloud technologies, or engineering application environments.
* Engineering computing expertise: Experience with VDI, engineering computing environments, cloud-hosting platforms, and enterprise-scale application delivery, including experience supporting engineering, BIM, GIS, digital delivery, simulation, or design application ecosystems.
* Data governance depth: A strong understanding of data governance, retention, archiving, recovery, and information lifecycle management practices, along with knowledge of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and data governance frameworks.
* Complex delivery leadership: Experience managing technical delivery portfolios and complex cross-functional initiatives using ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or comparable delivery methodologies.
* Global leadership and operating-model experience: Experience leading global technical teams and driving operating-model transformation, capability development, workforce planning, and organizational change.
* Financial and investment acumen: Strong financial management and technology investment experience, including budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment recommendations, and cost-optimization initiatives.
* Cloud-modernization capability: Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architectures, DaaS and VDI platforms, infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, and enterprise platform-modernization initiatives.
* Executive influence and communication: Excellent stakeholder-management, executive-communication, presentation, written, and spoken English skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical, operational, and business groups.

**Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. **VALUES**

  

**Care about transforming the Banking landscape.**

**Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.**

**Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.**

**Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.**

Title: Delivery Director
Description:

We provide businesses across the world with the infrastructure they need to connect, collaborate, and grow in the data-driven landscape of today. Our solutions focus on security, reliability, scalability, and sustainability, empowering our clients to truly achieve digital transformation. **Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with internal teams (design, procurement, operations, legal, business development etc) to align construction activities with business objectives
