Title: Technology Lead, Enterprise Platforms & Operation (Director)
Description:
**Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers**
The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.
  
  
**Ready to be part of the action?**
We are seeking a strategic, highly collaborative technology leader to take comprehensive ownership of our enterprise platforms and corporate ecosystem. As the
**Technology Lead, Enterprise Platforms and Operations**
, you will drive a holistic strategy to modernize our digital workplace, transforming disconnected processes and siloed applications into an integrated, frictionless employee experience.
  
  
Grounded in a workflow-first methodology, you will champion operational excellence across core productivity suites, workflow automation, custom web tools, and emerging AI technologies. You will act as the organizational "switchboard," bridging technical teams and executive business partners to ensure our technology portfolio directly enables business capabilities, scales efficiency, and delivers maximum ROI.
  
  

* This role reports to: Head of Corporate Technology Services
* Job Location: Hybrid (2-3 days in office) - based in Toronto, ON (100 Adelaide St W)

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Leadership & Platform Governance: Define and execute a multi-year strategic vision for core enterprise platforms—including Google Workspace, ServiceNow, Web/Digital platforms, desktop applications, and Gemini/AI initiatives. Establish governance, lifecycle management, and security guardrails in partnership with Cybersecurity and Risk teams.
* Ecosystem Synergy & Debt Reduction: Architect seamless integrations across disparate systems to remove operational friction, eliminate redundant applications, and systematically reduce technical debt. Map platform capabilities directly to business capabilities and the service catalog.
* Process Orchestration & Automation: Function as the central architect for workflow design, ensuring business processes are thoroughly re-engineered before applying automation to high-volume or high-friction areas.
* Service Management & Analytics: Establish and enforce rigorous Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Build data-driven performance dashboards to monitor platform health, user adoption rates, and license utilization to hold service owners strictly accountable.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management: Partner closely with Technology Leaders, HRIS/Finance Directors, and shared IT service teams to align platform roadmaps with business goals. Collaborate with HR and Internal Communications to drive adoption and training campaigns.
* Vendor & Budget Optimization: Direct strategic vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and align software roadmaps (including disruptive AI capabilities) to optimize SaaS spend and realize strong ROI.
* Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of platform managers, API developers, and technical specialists, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous upskilling, and innovation.

**Must Have(s)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
* Overall Experience: 10 to 12+ years of progressive leadership experience within IT operations, enterprise applications, or workplace technology environments.
* People Management: 5+ years of dedicated experience leading and mentoring high-performing software engineering or platform management teams.
* Platform Mastery: Proven track record of managing enterprise-scale deployments of core platforms such as Google Workspace, ServiceNow (ITSM/ITOM), and Enterprise ERP environments.
* Modern Technical Acumen: Deep familiarity with web architectures, API integrations, desktop application management, and agile product management workflows.
* Emerging Tech Proficiency: Practical experience integrating emerging AI tools, prompt engineering, and machine learning capabilities into existing enterprise suites.
* Strategic & Financial Mindset: Strong capabilities in budget oversight, vendor management, process optimization, and executive-level stakeholder management.

**Nice To Have(s)**

* Experience managing IT platform transformation within global or multi-office enterprise environments.
* Advanced certifications in ServiceNow, Google Workspace Administration, or ITIL Frameworks.

$160,000K/year - $180,000K/year CAD. Please note that the salary range included is a guideline only. The salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.

Title: VP, Delivery and Customer Success
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, Customer Success, you'll take the lead on client health across Appficiency's global delivery portfolio. This is a customer-first leadership role: you'll be the face of delivery excellence for our most strategic accounts, spending your time where it counts most - with clients and the teams who serve them. You'll build the kind of trust that turns successful implementations into long-term partnerships, and set the standard the rest of the organization looks to for keeping engagements on scope, on time, on budget, and on quality. We're looking for a delivery leader who has built their career inside project implementation or customer success - someone who knows what it takes to earn a client's confidence and keep it.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across your portfolio, building the kind of trust and consistency that keeps retention high and relationships strong for the long term
* Champion end-to-end delivery excellence, ensuring every engagement is meticulously planned, resourced, and executed within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standards
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than just a delivery contact
* Match your team's skill set to the demands of each engagement, building and maintaining a resource pool capable of scaling with the business
* Identify skill gaps across the team both technical and interpersonal, and partner with fellow delivery leaders to close them through coaching, training, and targeted hiring
* Provide the kind of direction and constructive feedback that helps your team consistently hit customer success KPIs, not just individual project milestones
* Turn strong delivery into business growth, actively supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities
* Build a client base that is referenceable, ensuring your accounts become some of Appficiency's strongest references
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same rigor you apply to client satisfaction, balancing commercial outcomes with delivery excellence

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A career built in delivery or project-implementation leadership and customer success ownership - you've sat close enough to execution to know what it actually takes to keep a client happy
* Direct experience owning the full client lifecycle post-go-live - hypercare transition, steady-state support, QBRs, renewal conversations, and escalation management
* Comfort operating with customer health metrics (NPS, CSAT, retention/churn) as core performance indicators, alongside traditional delivery metrics like scope, time, and budget
* 10+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7-8 of those years hands-on in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering
* 8-10 years working across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce; familiarity with AI-driven or productivity solutions (e.g., the Microsoft ecosystem) is a strong plus
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations, onsite and remote, on concurrent projects spanning one or more industries
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P&L statements
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an MBA
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client needs
* Applicant must reside in Toronto Canada.

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A track record of leading client-facing delivery organizations where retention and satisfaction are the primary measures of success, not just project throughput
* Deep, credible expertise across ERP, CRM, AI, and productivity platforms, built through real implementation experience across multiple industries
* Strong executive presence - the kind that lets you walk into a C-suite conversation and leave with the client's confidence intact or restored
* A demonstrated history of building, mentoring, and scaling delivery teams that consistently exceed client expectations
* A proven ability to turn satisfied clients into active advocates, converting implementation work into long-term, referenceable partnerships

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Your account portfolio consistently outperforms industry benchmarks for client retention, with false-starts and early terminations the exception, not the norm
* Engagements across your portfolio are delivered on scope, on time, on budget, and to quality standard as a matter of course, not an aspiration
* Strategic accounts become vocal advocates for Appficiency, actively referring new business and serving as references in sales conversations
* Skill gaps across your team are identified early and closed proactively, keeping your delivery capability ahead of client demand
* Your portfolio's profitability holds steady at target levels even as the book of business grows

* Execution Excellence: Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering multi-year, multi-team projects in excess of $2M from concept to completion.
* SaaS Implementation Expertise: Direct experience managing SaaS-based initiatives, including major platforms such as Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or the Google ecosystem.

* Inspirational Leadership: Demonstrated capacity to motivate, lead, and effectively manage diverse cross-functional teams toward project success.
* Stakeholder & Conflict Management: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Executive-Level Communication: Ability to distill intricate technical or delivery complexities into clear, concise, and actionable intelligence for senior leadership.
* Risk & Dependency Mapping: Highly proficient in identifying, visualizing, and proactively managing critical dependencies and risks across dozens of workstreams and teams.

Title: Senior Project Manager
Description:
Decima International is a professional services company, providing project management and controls services to clients in the United States and the Middle East. Our mission is to become the premier professional services provider across all industry sectors we are engaged in. To accomplish this, Decima International's founders established a simple yet powerful formula:

Approach each client engagement as a **partnership**, create an environment that attracts the **most talented professionals** and allows them to flourish, and regulate **growth** to maintain **excellence** in our service standards.

If you are interested in a long and rewarding career working with high-profile clients on some of the most challenging projects in the world, then Decima is where you belong. At Decima, you will be able to explore incredible growth and professional development opportunities.

We are looking for a driven and capable **Senior Project Manager** with experience in the **construction industry** to support us with the development of multiple data center projects for one of the top technology clients in the world. This is a client-facing role that requires strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, the ability to self-direct, client representation, and an emphasis on strong project management fundamentals.

You will play an integral role in mentoring staff, forming long-term relationships with clients, and pursuing new work, including strategy development, positioning, proposing, and negotiating contracts.

We are looking to bring in dedicated individuals with a passion for innovation and talent for multitasking in a fast-paced environment. We will help you grow, pursue, and fulfill what inspires you so we can make big impacts on the world, together.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Versed in modern project management techniques within complex, multi-functional organizations; have an understanding and knowledge of engineering, design, procurement and contracting, safety, construction, and commissioning.
* Establish a strong relationship with the client and communicate with both technical and management-level personnel.
* Manage assigned work from start to close out, covering all aspects related to work delivery to ensure that the work is conducted in a timely and effective manner.
* Prepare PowerPoint decks and present to management on progress, findings, and recommendations.
* Review project plans, requirements, and specifications.
* Prepare RFPs and support the process of contractor selection and contract award.
* Work with contractors to establish CPM baseline schedules.
* Perform resource analyses to identify potential bottlenecks and resource strain.
* Identify project risks, gaps, and opportunities, and provide recommendations to stakeholders to mitigate the impact of these risks and take advantage of opportunities.
* Facilitate, run, and chair project meetings (including OAC meetings) and maintain accurate meeting minutes and action items.
* Review and validate project progress, contractor pay applications, and invoices.
* Carry out financial and technical appraisals of project options. Perform feasibility studies, site surveys, and liaise with designers, engineers, superintendents, and construction managers as required.
* Support business development efforts by contributing to strategy development, positioning, proposing, and negotiating contracts.
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required qualifications:**

* **15+ years** of construction project management experience.
* Bachelor's degree in construction, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, project management, or a related technical field.
* An excellent understanding of construction, mechanical, and electrical systems.
* Strong working knowledge of pre-design and pre-construction, contract management, project delivery methods, building systems/components, and technology.
* Earned Value Management experience.
* Experience developing various types of reports, targeting different audiences.
* Experience in client-facing positions.
* Demonstrated ability to understand technical and complicated construction programs and the ability to communicate progress to both technical and management-level personnel.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate with any audience clearly and accurately.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's in construction management.
* Active membership in PMI, CCMA, or similar associations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Certified Construction Manager (CCM) certification.
* Strong background in data center development and construction.

**POSITION DETAILS**

* **Location (On-site):** Dubai, United Arab Emirates
* **Position:** Senior Project Manager
* **Position Classification:** Salary-based full-time hours

Title: Information Technology Project Manager
Industry: Software Development, IT System Training and Support, and IT System Design Services
Description:
The IT Project Manager delivers IT projects across the group and oversees business applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure coordination, vendors and IT governance. The role bridges business stakeholders, IT teams and technology partners, ensuring solutions meet business needs, are delivered on time and within approved scope and budget, and are transitioned smoothly into operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Project Management & Delivery**

* Lead IT projects end-to-end: initiation, requirements, planning, execution, testing, go-live, handover and closure.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestones, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs and dependency maps.
* Coordinate business stakeholders, internal IT teams, vendors and consultants to deliver agreed scope on time and within budget.
* Run project governance: steering committee and status reporting, action tracking, change control and escalation.
* Manage UAT, cutover, deployment and stabilization, and hand over cleanly to business and IT operations.
* Complete lessons learned, closure reports and knowledge transfer for every project.
* Provide or coordinate L1/L2 application support during the post-go-live stabilization period.

**2. Business Applications Management**

* Own the day-to-day management of core applications, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise systems.
* Coordinate with application vendors and implementation partners on support, incident resolution, enhancements, integrations, upgrades and patches.
* Work with business departments to understand processes and pain points, and translate requirements into functional and technical solutions.
* Maintain application roadmaps, enhancement backlogs and release plans, including testing and deployment.
* Keep application documentation, support procedures, access controls and vendor contacts current.
* Coordinate integrations across Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP and ERP, HR, property, finance and other systems.

**3. Microsoft 365 & Licensing**

* Manage Microsoft 365 subscriptions, license allocation, renewals, utilization and cost optimization.
* Work with Microsoft partners on licensing, technical issues and service changes.
* Oversee identity, access, administrative roles, security controls and compliance for Microsoft 365, together with the infrastructure and security teams.

**4. Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Coordinate the group's Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform environments with providers, vendors and internal technical teams.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, integration and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Track cloud usage and cost, and act on optimization opportunities.
* Ensure cloud environments follow approved architecture, security, access, backup and governance standards.

**5. Network, Server & Cybersecurity Coordination**

* Coordinate support of networks, servers, firewalls, VPN, backup and endpoint services with the IT technical team.
* Coordinate cybersecurity tooling, including Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, security updates, monitoring, access control, backup and DR improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure and security issues affecting business applications are escalated, tracked and resolved.

**6. Business Relationship & Solution Management**

* Act as the primary IT contact for business stakeholders across the group.
* Run workshops and requirement-gathering sessions with users and process owners.
* Prepare business cases, solution comparisons and vendor evaluations for management approval.
* Coordinate demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical assessments.

**7. IT Governance, Policies & Controls**

* Establish and maintain IT project governance standards, templates, reporting and controls.
* Develop, review and implement IT policies, procedures and operating guidelines.
* Ensure projects and IT services comply with policies, security requirements and internal controls.
* Maintain documentation for management, audit and compliance; support IT audits and close findings.
* Ensure approval, change, access and vendor management processes are followed.

**8. Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, system integrators, software providers, cloud providers and managed service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, deliverables and milestones; lead service reviews and improvement plans.

Title: Senior Manager - Operational Readiness - AA9
Description:
Lead the end-to-end handover process for District ICT Infrastructure services moving from delivery into live operations. The role ensures operational onboarding, documentation, support contracts, and knowledge transfer are completed to the required standard before service commencement.
  
  
**Key competencies**

* Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
* Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
* Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
* Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
* Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
* Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling

**Key Responsibilities**
**Handover Governance & Control:**

* Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems entering live operations
* Establish required handover deliverables, review checkpoints, sign-off criteria, and escalation principles
* Ensure handover governance is applied consistently across different District ICT Systems, vendors, and projects
* Maintain control over readiness status, approval pathways, and acceptance conditions

**Operational Onboarding & Service Activation**

* Oversee onboarding of services into ICC, ServiceNow, and related operational support processes
* Ensure support workflows, service structures, escalation paths, and operational contacts are established before go-live
* Confirm that service records, operational inventories, support dependencies, and relevant tool configurations are complete and usable
* Verify that the receiving operations environment is prepared to support the new or changed service from day one

**Documentation, Knowledge Transfer & Support Readiness**

* Ensure delivery teams provide complete documentation packs, SOPs, operating procedures, support guides, and technical records
* Lead the planning and execution of knowledge transfer to BAU teams, including operational training and competency development
* Confirm that operational teams understand the service, support model, known risks, and recovery procedures ahead of service commencement
* Ensure training gaps and documentation issues are identified early and addressed before handover sign-off
* Ensure Data Inputs into ITAM & CMDB

**Contracts, Risks & Reporting**

* Oversee support contract registration, warranty coverage transition, and support responsibilities for externally supported components
* Ensure contractual support obligations are reflected in the live support model and understood by operational teams
* Confirm third-party support contacts, service windows, and escalation commitments are documented and activated
* Track commercial dependencies that could affect service support after go-live

**Handover Risk & Management Reporting**

* Maintain a consolidated view of handover readiness, open risks, unresolved actions, and acceptance blockers
* Chair handover reviews and provide management with clear recommendations on transition readiness
* Escalate incomplete deliverables, support model gaps, or residual risks that may compromise stable BAU operation
* Drive closure of post-handover stabilization issues where formal follow-up is required

**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Delivery teams and system integrators: Handover deliverables, documentation and open actions
* ICC and BAU operations teams: Onboarding, training and day-one support readiness
* ServiceNow, ITAM and CMDB owners: Service records, asset data and tool configuration
* Vendors, OEMs and third-party support providers: Contracts, warranties and escalation commitments
* Procurement and contracts teams: Support obligations and commercial dependencies
* Senior management: Readiness recommendations, risks and escalations

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**About the Role:**

The **Manager, Workforce Planning & Business Optimization** will be responsible for developing the forecasting, capacity modelling, performance analytics, workforce intelligence, and business integration capabilities required to support Enterprise Contact Centre service delivery across current and future channels. The role combines workforce planning expertise with advanced analytics, reporting automation, AI/automation measurement, and enterprise technology integration to enable better decisions on staffing, service levels, cost-to-serve, and transformation readiness.

This role will build the analytical and integration foundation needed to support omni-channel operations across phone, email, assisted chat, workflow, digital servicing, and AI-enabled interactions. It will own the business integration lifecycle - from use-case definition and requirements through data/API integration, testing, operational readiness, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization - while partnering with Technology and platform teams on solution delivery. It will provide executive-ready insights that connect workforce assumptions to client experience, advisor experience, operational performance, technology outcomes, and enterprise transformation priorities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build accurate and scalable workforce models across phone, email, chat, digital channels, workflow queues, and AI-enabled work.
* Own the business integration lifecycle for WFM analytics and AI capabilities, from use-case evaluation and requirements through testing, implementation, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization.
* Translate cloud-based and AI-enabled technical capabilities into practical workflows, functional requirements, data requirements, and operational processes.
* Improve connectivity across WFM, CCaaS, CRM, workflow, data, and enterprise platforms through governed APIs, data flows, and reusable integrations.
* Automate reporting and reduce reliance on manual downloads, spreadsheets, and one-time analysis.
* Validate the realized benefits and service impacts of automation, and AI/digital workers.
* Ensure new capabilities are scalable, reliable, resilient, secure, privacy-aligned, supportable, cost-effective, and compliant with internal standards.
* Provide decision-grade insights for monthly, quarterly, annual, and business planning cycles.
* Support service-safe transformation by identifying workforce, integration, data, and adoption risks early and recommending mitigation options.
* Advance segmentation and capacity models across IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments to align staffing with changing volume mix, service expectations, and reporting requirements.
* Build sustainable capability through integration standards, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, contact centre analytics, operations analytics, business intelligence, data science, systems integration, AI enablement, or related function.
* Experience building forecasting, capacity, performance, or scenario models and applying them to operational or strategic decisions.
* Transformation Experience operationalizing, automation, AI, or technology-enabled capability in a production or enterprise environment.
* Advanced Power BI or equivalent reporting experience, strong SQL, and advanced Excel skills.
* Experience translating business needs and analytical outputs into functional, data, or integration requirements and recommendations for operational or executive decision-making.
* Experience defining, implementing, or supporting data/API integrations across WFM, contact centre, cloud, or enterprise platforms.
* Working knowledge of cloud-based data/AI environments, system architecture concepts, data quality, security, privacy, and technology governance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or advanced certification in Data Science, Business Analytics, AI, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or other regulated environments, with exposure to omni-channel contact centre operations.
* Proficiency with workforce management platforms (Verint, Calabrio, NICE, Genesys), cloud technologies (AWS, Salesforce, Azure), and advanced analytics tools (Python, R, Power BI, Looker, SQL).
* Experience implementing AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, including systems integration, operational readiness, and benefits realization.
* Strong understanding of data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership to influence strategic workforce planning, technology roadmaps, and business transformation initiatives.

Title: Senior Director, Corporate Applications
Description:
Our mission is to create the Experience of a Lifetime for our employees, so they can, in turn, create the Experience of a Lifetime for our guests. We own and operate the most renowned destination resorts in the world as well as regional and local ski areas outside major cities, and connect them all through one unrivaled network. We are looking for ambitious leaders, innovators and creators to join our talented team. If you’re ready to pursue your fullest potential, we want to get to know you!

Candidates for year-round positions are reviewed on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted up to 90 days after the posting date, or until the position is filled (whichever is first).

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The Senior Director, Corporate Applications is a senior technology leader responsible for leading Vail Resorts' HR Technology, Finance Technology, ServiceNow, and Enterprise Applications portfolios. This leader has end-to-end accountability for strategy, delivery, operations, investment, talent, and organizational effectiveness across critical enterprise platforms.

This role requires an experienced leader of leaders who can independently build trusted relationships with senior executives, navigate competing priorities, and drive alignment and decisions across HR, Finance, Technology, and enterprise functions. The Senior Director will develop a clear point of view from complex business challenges and translate it into actionable strategies, recommendations, roadmaps, investments, and executive-ready communications.

This leader will build strong leadership capability and operating discipline across Corporate Applications, creating clear accountability for priorities, delivery, production health, security, reliability, and business outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with strong operational leadership and can lead the organization with strong ownership, sound judgment, and effective partnership.

**Job Specifications:**

* Starting Wage: $181,487 - $259,268 + Annual Bonus + Equity

* Employment Type: Year Round

* Shift Type: Full Time hours available

* Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age

* Housing Availability: No

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead the Corporate Applications organization across HR Technology, Finance Technology, ServiceNow, and Enterprise Applications, with end-to-end accountability for strategy, delivery, operations, talent, and business outcomes.
* Build and maintain trusted executive partnerships across HR, Finance, Technology, and other enterprise functions; independently navigate competing priorities, resolve complex issues, and drive alignment and decisions with senior leaders.
* Develop a clear point of view from complex business challenges and translate it into actionable strategies, recommendations, multi-year roadmaps, investment priorities, and executive-ready presentations.
* Establish and lead portfolio governance, prioritization, funding, and operating rhythms that align technology investments with business objectives and create consistency across application teams.
* Own the operating health of Corporate Applications, establishing clear accountability and delivery discipline across platform operations, production health, security, reliability, risk, technical debt, and modernization.
* Balance competing business and technology demands across growth, operational excellence, platform sustainability, and long-term enterprise value, making clear trade-offs and escalating decisions when needed.
* Build and lead a high-performing leadership team by developing strong Directors, strengthening succession, raising organizational capability, and developing talent, strengthening capability, and aligning capacity to priorities.
* Hold internal teams, vendors, managed service providers, and strategic partners accountable for commitments, quality, service performance, financial stewardship, and measurable outcomes.
* Create a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, innovation, and customer-focused delivery across the Corporate Applications organization.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience across enterprise technology, Corporate Applications, HR Technology, Finance Technology, ServiceNow, or digital transformation functions.
* 6+ years of experience leading managers and Directors, developing high-performing leadership teams, and building sustainable organizational capability.
* Proven executive-level stakeholder leadership with the ability to independently build trusted relationships, navigate competing priorities, resolve conflict, and influence senior leaders across a complex organization.
* Demonstrated strategic thinking and executive communication, including the ability to take complex business problems, develop a point of view, and translate it into clear strategies, recommendations, roadmaps, investment decisions, and executive-level presentations.
* Experience leading multiple application portfolios, including HR Technology, Finance Technology, Enterprise Applications, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise technology functions.
* Demonstrated success establishing operational rigor, clear accountability, portfolio governance, prioritization, delivery discipline, production health, and performance management across a large technology organization.
* Proven experience as a leader of leaders, including developing strong Directors, developing talent and strengthening organizational capability, strengthening succession, and holding teams and partners accountable for outcomes.
* Experience overseeing enterprise platforms such as Workday, Oracle/PeopleSoft, ServiceNow, SuccessFactors, workforce management, or similar technologies.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, managed services, systems integrators, and technology partnerships, including accountability for service quality, performance, and value.
* Strong business and financial acumen with experience shaping technology investments, managing budgets, and connecting portfolio decisions to measurable business outcomes.
* Must be comfortable operating in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment and able to learn new and emerging concepts quickly.

The expected Total Compensation for this role is $181,487 - $259,268 + Annual Bonus + Equity. Individual compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors.

* MORE employee discounts on lodging, food, gear, and mountain shuttles
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Employee Assistance Program

Title: Head - Payments Security Compliance, Security & Privacy Regulatory Enablement (SPRe)
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Security & Privacy Regulatory Enablement (SPRe) team is the single regulatory enablement engine for Amazon's security, privacy, and AI compliance needs. We take any new regulatory requirement from initial publication to demonstrated compliance across three domains — Security, Privacy, and AI — using a repeatable, scalable operating model (Anticipate Enable Assure).  
  
Amazon operates regulated payment entities across six major jurisdictions — US, UK, EU, India, Singapore, and MENA — each subject to distinct security compliance regimes including PCI DSS, local regulatory security frameworks, and supervisory authority examinations. The Payments Security Compliance (PSC) function within SPRe manages the full audit and compliance lifecycle for these entities.  
  
We are seeking an experienced Payments Security Compliance Lead to own and scale the operational delivery of payments security audits, regulatory examinations, and compliance programmes across all regulated jurisdictions. This is a people management role leading a team of security compliance specialists, with responsibility for audit lifecycle management, regulatory relationship stewardship, operational excellence, team development, and delivery metrics.  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in payments security compliance (PCI DSS, financial services regulatory regimes), has led audit/compliance teams at scale across multiple jurisdictions, and can build a high-performing, geographically distributed team. You will own the day-to-day delivery of payments security audits globally, manage relationships with QSAs, external auditors, and regulatory examiners, and drive continuous improvement in compliance operations.  
  
A day in the life  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  
  
About the team  
SPRe operates through three interconnected gears forming a continuous flywheel: \*\*Anticipate\*\* (regulatory engagement and horizon scanning), \*\*Enable\*\* (programme design and control framework development), and \*\*Assure\*\* (external audit delivery and regulatory examination management). This role leads Payments Security Compliance within the Assure function — the largest operational workstream within SPRe, covering 40+ recurring audit programmes across six regulated jurisdictions.  
  
The team you will lead includes security compliance specialists based across India (Bengaluru), Europe (London, Luxembourg), and the US. You will report to SPRe's Senior Manager and work closely with the Payments Business, Payments Security, Legal, Risk & Compliance, Technology teams.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
* 10+ years of experience in information security compliance, payments security, audit, governance, or risk management — with deep expertise in payments industry security frameworks (PCI DSS, financial services regulatory security regimes)
* 5+ years of people management experience, including managing teams of 5+ professionals across multiple geographies and time zones
* Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end external audit delivery — managing relationships with QSAs, Big 4 auditors, regulatory examiners, or equivalent
* Proven track record of managing PCI DSS compliance programmes — including scoping, SAQ/ROC processes, evidence coordination, and finding remediation
* Experience managing audit/compliance programmes across multiple jurisdictions with different regulatory regimes simultaneously
* Strong skills in security principles — risk-based thinking, control design, defense in depth, least privilege access, preventative vs detective controls

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (e.g. security, privacy, SOX, HIPAA etc.)
* 6+ years of senior leadership development and talent management experience
* Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps
* Experience managing payments security compliance programmes for major technology companies, fintechs, or regulated financial services entities across multiple jurisdictions
* Professional certifications: QSA, PCIP, CISA, CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar
* Experience with EU/UK payments regulatory landscape — EBA guidelines, PSD2 security requirements, FCA/PRA operational resilience, DORA
* Experience with US payments regulatory landscape — NYDFS Part 500, state money transmitter regulations, GLBA

- - Knowledge of emerging regulatory frameworks (NIS2, DORA, Cyber Resilience Act) and their impact on payments infrastructure  

* Experience with GRC platforms, audit management tools, and automation of evidence collection at scale
* Experience with process improvement methodologies and driving operational efficiency in audit delivery
* Ability to maintain trusted relationships with regulators, auditors, and supervisory authorities across multiple jurisdictions

**Why Black & Veatch?**

  

At Black & Veatch, you’ll be part of work that matters—designing, creating, and building the infrastructure communities rely on every day, from concept through execution.

  

We care about how the work gets done as much as what we build. Safety is built into every decision, and people look out for each other—speaking up, collaborating, and doing the right thing because it affects real lives.

  

You’ll work alongside teams solving complex challenges and turning ideas into solutions that perform in the real world—gaining hands-on experience across projects, technologies, and disciplines.

  

Ownership shows up in how we work. We take responsibility for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and take pride in what we deliver. As a 100% employee-owned company, employees share in the long-term success we build together.

  

With flexible ways of working and meaningful development opportunities, you’ll build a career you can be proud to stand behind.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to establish, scale and own enterprise shared AI capabilities on the BVInfraIQ digital products platform. This role will define the strategy, service portfolio, roadmap, operating model and product adoption approach for reusable AI services and supporting governance model. This role will independently shape the capability maturity path that enables Black & Veatch to scale AI responsibly, translating business priorities, user needs, risk requirements and emerging technology into a value-based roadmap and backlog.

  

Operating across complex and interdependent workstreams, this senior individual contributor will partner with Product Management, BVInfraIQ Platform & Product Engineering, Data and AI Engineering, Legal, Information Security, Architecture and business leaders. The successful candidate is not expected to be an expert in every AI technology or governance principle, but must bring deep knowledge of core AI concepts, strong platform or enterprise product management experience, and sufficient technical acumen to make informed product and investment decisions.

  

**Enterprise AI Strategy and Roadmap**

* Define and maintain the multi-year platform strategy, maturity path and integrated roadmap for AI Services and the AI Governance Framework on BVInfraIQ platform, aligned with enterprise strategy, DPOM principles and platform priorities.
* Translate business problems, user research, regulatory considerations and technology trends into product opportunities, outcome statements and investment recommendations.
* Exercise independent judgment to balance near-term delivery, longer-term platform maturity, enterprise reuse, risk and cost across multiple workstreams.

**Product Vision, Prioritization and Backlog**

* Conduct continuous discovery with digital product teams and business stakeholders to understand AI use cases, adoption barriers, workflow friction, unmet platform needs, and opportunities for enterprise reuse.
* Own an outcome-oriented backlog with clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies and definitions of done.
* Apply transparent prioritization based on strategic alignment, user and enterprise value, risk reduction, reuse potential, urgency, effort, cost and dependency enablement.
* Lead quarterly and increment planning; communicate sequencing, capacity constraints, decisions and roadmap changes across Product, Platform, Data and AI, and Engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**AI Services and BVInfraIQ Platform Capabilities**

* Define the initial and target portfolio of shared AI services based on digital product needs, enterprise priorities, technical feasibility, expected reuse, cost, and risk.
* Own and prioritize reusable AI services such as model access patterns, prompt and agent services, retrieval and grounding, evaluation, telemetry, feedback loops and cost controls.
* Determine which capabilities should be delivered as shared platform services, provided through approved external services, embedded within individual products, or deferred.
* Support build, buy, partner, reuse, and retire decisions for AI models, platforms, tools, and external services based on business fit, technical performance, and contractual constraints.
* Partner with platform Engineering to define service boundaries, platform requirements, adoption pathways, documentation and service-level expectations.
* Treat shared AI capabilities as products with named consumers, clear service ownership, documented service levels, adoption targets, support expectations, unit economics and lifecycle plans.

**AI Governance and Responsible AI**

* Own the roadmap and operationalize AI governance, including intake, risk classification, approval workflows, model and agent inventory, evaluation evidence, human oversight, monitoring, auditability and lifecycle controls.
* Partner with Legal, Information Security, Architecture, Privacy, Data, business stakeholders, and the AI Governance Committee to translate policies, risk requirements, and AI data-rights considerations, into practical platform capabilities, product requirements, and stage-gated workflows proportionate to intended business value, technical risk, and data sensitivity. Support the ongoing development and refinement of related policies and standards.
* Embed governance into product and developer workflows, including requirements for responsible use, performance, traceability, exceptions and retirement, so teams can move quickly with appropriate oversight.

**Cross-Functional Delivery and Product Lifecycle**

* Partner with Engineering for product rituals to move prioritized capabilities through discovery, design, architecture, build, test, release and operational readiness.
* Partner with UX, Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity and Operations to ensure capabilities are usable, scalable, secure, resilient and supportable.
* Define fit-for-purpose acceptance and evaluation methods for predictive, generative and agentic AI, including business accuracy, safety, usability, latency, reliability and cost.
* Establish observability, feedback and lifecycle measures; guide user acceptance, rollout, change enablement and post-launch improvement.

**Executive Communication, Influence and Adoption**

* Translate complex AI, governance and technical trade-offs into clear recommendations for executives, product leaders, engineers and business stakeholders.
* Build alignment across groups with different objectives and risk tolerances; make decisions, rationale, assumptions and accountabilities visible.
* Act as a product-led advocate for responsible AI adoption and scalable BVInfraIQ platform capabilities across Black & Veatch.

**Management Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

Supervises work of others. Responsible for hiring, discipline, and pay administration of their subordinates.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 12+ years in product management and/or platform leadership for multi-tenant SaaS, internal platforms, or large-scale shared services; proven track record shipping platform capabilities used by multiple teams.
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in product management, platform product management, data and analytics products, enterprise technology or related roles, including leadership of multiple complex workstreams.
* 2+ years of direct experience shaping or delivering AI/ML, generative AI, intelligent automation, data platform or AI-enabled software capabilities.
* Strong foundational understanding of predictive AI, machine learning, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, data pipelines, APIs, cloud platforms and model lifecycle concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to define enterprise product strategy, roadmaps, outcome measures and prioritized backlogs for platforms or shared services.
* Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions without direct authority.
* Strong business judgment, structured problem solving and demonstrated success operating independently amid ambiguity, evolving technology and competing priorities.
* Experience with responsible AI, model risk management, legal privacy, data rights, security, audit, regulatory compliance or enterprise governance workflows.
* Working knowledge of AI evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, model and agent monitoring, prompt management, retrieval systems, observability and AI cost governance.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry or comparable enterprise cloud AI platforms, and familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tooling such as Langfuse.
* Experience delivering shared capabilities across multiple products, business units or Engineering teams in regulated or mission-critical environments.

**Communication and Cultural Fit**

* Enterprise-minded and outcome-focused, with a commitment to shared value, platform reuse and measurable capability maturity.
