Group Services’ greatest strength lies in its people; their collective capabilities serve as the driving force of the company. Dedicated to creating a vibrant talent hub where challenging the norm leads to innovation, collaboration fuels creativity and caring for people and partners cultivates strong relationships, Group Services aims to build a foundation for sustained success.

As a business that views success as a shared journey and celebrates every achievement along the way, Group Services offers the opportunity to grow, develop skills and make a meaningful impact.

Dubai Holding Group Services proudly supports a diverse portfolio of companies, including:

* Dubai Holding Real Estate
* Dubai Holding Entertainment
* Dubai Holding Community Management
* Dubai Holding Land Estates
* Dubai Holding Hospitality
* Dubai Holding Investments
* Dubai Holding Asset Management

**About the Job:**

Dubai Holding Group Services is seeking a Director – Source to Pay Excellence to lead the enterprise-wide transformation of Source-to-Pay services across Dubai Holding. This is a senior leadership role with accountability for shaping the S2P transformation agenda, strengthening the operating model, improving end-to-end service performance and enabling technology-led ways of working across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management and Purchase-to-Pay.

The role requires a credible transformation leader who can operate at executive level, translate business priorities into practical delivery roadmaps, challenge current ways of working, and mobilise cross-functional stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, DHIT, Procurement and Finance. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performing S2P Excellence capability and establish the foundations for measurable, sustainable value realisation.

**Key Role and Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Transformation Scope**

* Own the Source-to-Pay excellence agenda across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management, Supplier Enablement and Purchase-to-Pay, ensuring transformation priorities are aligned to business needs and Group Services strategic objectives.
* Assess current operating models, process performance, governance, system utilisation and customer pain points to identify material improvement opportunities.
* Develop practical transformation roadmaps, business cases and implementation plans that improve service quality, cycle time, compliance, user experience and value delivery.

**Delivery Leadership and Governance**

* Act as the senior figurehead for S2P transformation, providing direction, challenge and escalation support across complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Lead prioritisation of transformation opportunities using Voice of the Customer input, operational data, service metrics, risk indicators and strategic value potential.
* Manage approvals for key transformation documentation, including business requirements, design decisions, delivery milestones, stakeholder sign-offs and change readiness outputs.
* Partner with DHIT and technology suppliers to ensure system enhancements, Oracle Fusion optimisation and digital enablement initiatives are business-led, well governed and adoption-focused.

**Stakeholder, Change and Value Realisation**

* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Risk, Compliance and IT.
* Work with Change and Communications teams to ensure transformation activity is supported by clear engagement, training, adoption and transition plans.
* Define measurable success criteria and benefits tracking for each major S2P initiative, ensuring improvements are evidenced through data and embedded into service performance management.
* Lead, coach and develop the S2P Excellence Team, setting clear priorities, standards and ways of working for a high-performing transformation capability.

**Indicative Measures of Success**

* Clear, prioritised S2P transformation roadmap endorsed by senior stakeholders.
* Improved process efficiency, cycle time, compliance, user adoption and service experience across priority S2P processes.
* Higher utilisation and optimisation of existing enterprise technology, particularly Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities.
* A credible S2P Excellence function recognised for driving practical, measurable and sustainable transformation outcomes.

**About You:**

**Qualifications**

* Degree-qualified, ideally in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Engineering, Technology or a related discipline.
* Relevant transformation, procurement, shared services, Lean Six Sigma, change management or programme delivery qualifications would be advantageous.

**Experience**

* 10+ years’ experience in Procurement, Source-to-Pay, Finance operations, shared services or enterprise transformation, including significant exposure to complex multi-business environments.
* Proven track record leading end-to-end process transformation from opportunity identification and business case development through to delivery, adoption and benefits realisation.
* Strong understanding of S2P technologies, ERP-enabled process design and Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities, with the ability to work effectively with IT and implementation partners.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders, managing governance forums, resolving cross-functional issues and influencing decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Experience building or leading small expert teams, setting delivery standards and developing capability in transformation, process excellence or service improvement.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Deep knowledge of Source-to-Pay process design, controls, policy alignment, service management and continuous improvement.
* Ability to convert data, VOC feedback and operational pain points into prioritised transformation opportunities with clear value cases.
* Strong business analysis capability, including process mapping, requirements definition, KPI design, benefits tracking and transformation reporting.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of how procurement transformation contributes to efficiency, governance, service quality and enterprise value.

**About the Benefits:**

At Dubai Holding, we are committed to nurturing the success and well-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing pioneering candidates who aspire to make a meaningful impact on the future of Dubai.

Title: Client Consulting Manager; Client Consulting
Description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, driving tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments, and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA is currently undergoing an AI transformation — embedding generative AI into how we work, how we deliver, and what we offer. This role is a hands-on, manager-level contributor to that transformation.

Role Summary:

Based in Dubai, the Manager, Generative AI will lead hands-on development and delivery of AI solutions that improve the quality, speed, and scalability of VCA consulting. Working with consultants, leadership, and external technology partners, the role combines coding and technical delivery with ownership of reusable tools, internal knowledge and search capabilities, vendor performance, and cross-regional and global adoption.

Specific Responsibilities Include:

* Shape the reusable tool portfolio: Identify high-value local workflows and methodologies, define requirements with consulting teams, and drive their conversion into reusable AI tools for the firm's broader tool catalog.
* Own hands-on technical delivery: Architect, build, and maintain production-grade AI agents, custom skills, automated workflows, and RAG pipelines, integrating LLM APIs and SDKs into internal and client-facing solutions. Scale internal AI knowledge and search capabilities with external technology vendors, incorporating user feedback and relevant advances in models and frameworks.
* Manage technology vendor relationships: Align scope, responsibilities, and delivery plans; oversee quality and timelines; and resolve dependencies to achieve agreed outcomes.
* Drive adoption and knowledge sharing: Equip consultants to use AI solutions effectively through practical guidance and enablement, and coordinate cross-regional and global sharing, reuse, and adoption of locally developed tools and practices.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related STEM field, with 4-6 years of experience in professional or project settings.
* Consulting experience at a management consulting firm or a strategy function of a financial institution.
* Experience managing technology vendors or external partners and coordinating delivery across teams or regions.
* Ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, learn and apply new technologies independently, and execute autonomously amid shifting priorities.
* Demonstrated hands-on GenAI development experience and strong Python skills, including building agents and integrating LLM APIs; working knowledge of prompt engineering, agent frameworks, vector databases, or RAG patterns. JavaScript or TypeScript familiarity is a plus.
* Personal projects or GitHub portfolio showing GenAI work (agents, bots, tools, integrations) is a plus.
* Experience with agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar) is a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and basic DevOps (containers, CI/CD) is a plus.
* Interest in payments, fintech, or financial services.Fluency in English is mandatory; Russian or Arabic is a plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title: Senior Security Program Manager
Description:
**About noon**

noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress - six years in, but only 5% done.

**noon’s mission:**
Ring every doorbell, every day.

**Role Overview - Senior Security Program Manager**

Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.

The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands-on and cross-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.

You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams

**Who we need?**

* Senior PM experience running cross-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.

**Preferred experience**

* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high-scale consumer internet, e-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.

Is this you?

Title: Director of Information Technology
Description:
CarltonOne is a global B2B technology leader, and part of the Goldman Sachs portfolio, helping organizations around the world reward and inspire exceptional people. Our solutions empower employees to be more productive, sales teams to perform at their best, and customers to stay engaged and loyal.

Our platform powers the global engagement industry, enabling companies to deliver impactful employee recognition, customer loyalty, rewards, sales, and channel incentive programs. We partner with over
**450 clients**
,
**500 vendors**
, and serve
**14 million members**
across
**185 countries**
.

Beyond engagement, every CarltonOne solution drives our eco-action mission: funding tree planting to help restore the planet. To date, we’ve funded over
**21 million trees**
and are on track to plant millions more each year. Learn more at
carltonone.com
.

**About the Opportunity:**

CarltonOne is seeking a highly motivated Director, Information Technology to lead CarltonOne's global enterprise IT function, owning IT strategy, service management, governance, and employee technology experience.

This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class employee technology experience across the organization, ensuring employees have the tools, systems, support, and infrastructure they need to be productive and successful. The Director, IT will lead internal IT support, service delivery, endpoint management, identity and access management, collaboration tools, workplace technology initiatives, and global hardware operations across CarltonOne's international workforce.

This is a strategic leadership role. The Director, IT is accountable for the outcomes of IT service delivery rather than working the support queue, leading through managers, team leads, and managed service partners who handle Level 1 and Level 2 support. The Director serves as the senior escalation point and leader during major IT and security incidents, and focuses on strengthening process, governance, and measurement to deliver an exceptional, proactive employee experience. The successful candidate will focus on improving service levels, modernizing IT processes, strengthening security practices, and scaling internal technology operations to support a growing global organization.

**Responsibilities:**

**IT Service Management & Incident Leadership**

* Own CarltonOne's global IT operating model, including service desk structure, tiered support (L1/L2/L3), escalation paths, and the balance of in-house and managed service provider (MSP) coverage.
* Hold the service desk and support partners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution of employee requests and issues, without personally working day-to-day L1/L2 tickets.
* Define and publish SLAs, experience level agreements (XLAs), and an IT performance scorecard covering CSAT, first-contact resolution, mean time to resolve, SLA attainment, backlog age, and reopen rates, reported monthly to executive leadership.
* Run a continuous improvement program driven by ticket trend analysis, employee feedback, and experience data, with the goal of reducing ticket volume per employee year over year.
* Ensure consistent delivery of IT services across all regions and time zones.
* Act as Major Incident Manager and senior escalation point for high-impact IT outages, leading coordinated response, stakeholder communications, and service restoration.
* Partner with Information Security to support the response to security incidents, including containment of affected accounts and devices, evidence preservation, and executive communication, in line with the incident response plan.
* Implement a problem management practice that uses root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to eliminate recurring issues, with tracked corrective actions.
* Establish change, release, and configuration management processes that reduce change-related incidents and protect service stability.
* Own Jira Service Management as the IT service management platform, driving workflow design, automation, SLA tracking, and reporting.
* Partner with SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams to align IT processes such as access, change, and incident management with production operations, and provide the internal tools and access they need.
* Own the IT service management (ITSM) platform roadmap, service catalogue, and knowledge base, aligned to ITIL 4 practices.

**Employee Technology Experience**

* Develop and enhance the overall employee technology experience across the organization.
* Ensure employees have access to reliable hardware, software, collaboration tools, and support resources regardless of location.
* Partner with business leaders to understand technology needs and improve workplace productivity.
* Evaluate and implement technologies that improve employee efficiency, collaboration, and engagement.
* Champion self-service support resources, knowledge management programs, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Shift IT from reactive to proactive by using monitoring, digital employee experience (DEX) tooling, and endpoint analytics to detect and resolve issues before employees are affected.
* Measure employee technology sentiment through regular surveys and an IT Net Promoter Score, and act on the results with visible follow-through.
* Promote a shift-left approach that moves common requests to self-service and automation, freeing the team for higher-value work.
* Create seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences through standardized technology processes.

**Global Hardware & Employee Technology Management**

* Own CarltonOne's global hardware procurement, deployment, lifecycle management, and asset governance strategy.
* Develop and manage scalable processes for onboarding and offboarding employees across Canada, the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other international locations.
* Partner with global vendors, distributors, and logistics providers to ensure timely delivery, replacement, retrieval, and support of employee equipment worldwide.
* Establish global standards for laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and collaboration technology to provide a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee hardware inventory management, asset tracking, auditing, and recovery programs across all regions.
* Manage relationships with international hardware partners and service providers to optimize cost, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Develop regional technology deployment strategies that account for customs requirements, shipping timelines, local regulations, and business needs.
* Ensure all employee devices are properly configured, secured, encrypted, and compliant with company security standards prior to deployment.
* Partner with Information Security teams to maintain endpoint management, device compliance, and security controls globally.
* Lead technology refresh programs and lifecycle planning to ensure employees have access to modern and reliable equipment.
* Establish reporting and KPIs related to deployment timelines, inventory accuracy, hardware utilization, asset recovery, and employee satisfaction.

**IT Leadership & Talent**

* Build, lead, and develop a global IT organization, including people managers, team leads, and specialists, and manage MSP and outsourced support partners.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
* Foster a customer-first service culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and problem resolution.
* Design staffing models, global coverage, escalation processes, and on-call rotations so that routine support across all time zones is delivered by the team and its partners.
* Promote knowledge sharing, process consistency, and operational excellence across the team.
* Build a high-performing IT organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing global workforce.

**Infrastructure & Workplace Technology**

* Oversee the management of employee technology including laptops, mobile devices, conference room systems, printers, and collaboration tools.
* Ensure reliable operation of corporate productivity platforms including Microsoft 365, communication platforms, and workplace technologies.
* Support office technology infrastructure across multiple global locations.
* Own software licensing and SaaS governance, including licence optimization, application rationalization, and shadow IT controls.
* Identify opportunities to modernize and standardize workplace technology solutions.

**Identity, Access Management & IT Security**

* Oversee user provisioning, deprovisioning, and identity and access management processes.
* Partner closely with Information Security teams to maintain secure access controls and endpoint security standards.
* Support security awareness initiatives and IT compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to IT policies, security best practices, and governance standards.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to IT operations and controls.
* Help strengthen the company's security posture through proactive management of employee technology and access controls.

**Vendor & Technology Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, service providers, telecommunications partners, and technology suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts, licensing agreements, and support arrangements.
* Evaluate technology investments and recommend solutions that align with business requirements and budgets.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure service commitments are achieved.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and improve operational efficiency.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise IT projects from planning through implementation and ongoing support.
* Support technology rollouts, infrastructure upgrades, collaboration platform enhancements, and automation initiatives.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Security, Operations, and Technology teams on cross-functional projects.
* Develop project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive automation and process improvement initiatives that increase productivity and reduce manual effort.

**IT Strategy, Governance, Risk & Business Continuity**

* Develop and own a multi-year IT strategy and roadmap aligned to CarltonOne's business objectives and growth plans.
* Own the IT operating and capital budget, with clear reporting on spend, cost per employee, and return on technology investments, including the cost, utilization, and value of software, SaaS, and AI tools.
* Manage IT expenses through SAP Concur, ensuring policy compliance, accurate cost allocation, and timely financial reporting.
* Establish and maintain IT operational policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Chair IT governance forums, such as a change advisory board and a technology steering committee, to prioritize demand and investment.
* Ensure compliance with corporate requirements, security policies, and audit standards, including ownership of IT general controls (ITGCs) and implementation and continuous compliance with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, and remediation of findings.
* Maintain accurate documentation of systems, assets, processes, and support procedures.
* Own disaster recovery planning and regular testing for internal systems and employee technologies, and partner with the business on continuity planning.
* Maintain an IT risk register, report key risks to leadership, and own mitigation plans through to closure.

**Qualifications:**

* **10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in IT leadership, with experience managing managers and/or managed service partners.**
* Experience leading internal IT operations, service desk, workplace technology, or enterprise support teams.
* Experience leading internal IT within a SaaS company, including supporting SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams with access management, tooling, change coordination, and incident collaboration.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace technologies.
* Proven experience managing global hardware deployment and asset lifecycle programs.
* Experience supporting distributed workforces across multiple countries and time zones.
* Expert in ITIL 4 and IT service management (ITSM), with a proven record of designing, implementing, and maturing incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management processes.
* Hands-on experience implementing and administering Jira Service Management, including workflows, service catalogue, SLAs, automation, and reporting.
* Proven experience implementing and improving controls aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, remediation of findings, and ongoing compliance.
* Proven track record leading major incident response and partnering with security teams on security incident response.
* Demonstrated use of data, KPIs, and experience metrics to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Proven experience owning and managing an IT budget, including forecasting, variance tracking, and reporting to leadership on the financial performance and return on investment of software, SaaS, and AI tool spend.
* Experience using SAP Concur for IT expense management, including expense policy, approvals, and spend reporting.
* Experience managing vendors, software licensing, and technology procurement.
* Proven experience leading IT projects and operational improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Strong customer service mindset with a focus on employee experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a global workforce across North America, South America, Europe, and APAC.
* Experience with IT governance and control frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, or ISO 20000.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, endpoint security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting HRIS, Finance, and SaaS business applications.
* ITIL 4, Atlassian (Jira Service Management), Microsoft, CISSP, CISM, or related certifications.

**Additional Perks**

Here are some additional perks that we provide:

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Vacation plus personal days.
* Access to our employee benefits portal for exclusive discounts.
* Monthly company-wide events, celebrations, and team activities.
* Bravo reward points program for recognition and appreciation.
* Convenient office location close to public transit.

**How to Apply**

If this great opportunity looks rewarding to you, let’s connect. Our online application will give you the option to apply to this role directly.

The target hiring range for this position is $115,000 to $135,000 Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. If we can make this easier through accommodation in the recruitment process, or if you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact us with the “Help” button in the application.

We will review applications, with priority given to those who have completed the assessment, and look forward to hearing from you.

Title: Director, Technology, Campana Systems
Description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this** **link** **directly.**

  

**Who we are**

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

**About Campana Systems**

Campana Systems, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized software solutions for AAA and CAA auto clubs across North America. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, Campana has built long-standing relationships with organizations that rely on its technology to manage their operations and deliver services to their members.

Our AXIS platform brings together membership management, customer relationship management, emergency roadside assistance, travel services, and business intelligence in an integrated suite of solutions. Looking ahead, we are focused on evolving our technology, strengthening our platform capabilities, and finding new ways to help our customers work more efficiently and deliver better member experiences.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director, Technology to lead the evolution of Campana Systems’ technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and AXIS platform. In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.

* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

We are a global product and platform engineering company, headquartered in Toronto, with around 1,000 engineers across North America and India. We have been building software for fifteen years.

Almost everything we do is custom product and platform development on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud—not package configuration, managed services or ticket queues. Reporting to the CTO, you will define product and digital strategy, guide discovery and experience design, and align product roadmaps with technical feasibility and measurable business outcomes. You will work closely with the CTO, engineering leaders, Business Development, Sales, Marketing and Operations.

This role combines product leadership, technology strategy and a consulting mindset. You should be comfortable facilitating an executive workshop, challenging a product assumption, developing a business case and guiding teams from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy and Roadmaps**

* Lead product and digital strategy engagements, translating client objectives into clear product visions, roadmaps and investment priorities.
* Assess user needs, market opportunities, competitive offerings and technology trends to inform product decisions.
* Develop business cases that define expected value, costs, risks, dependencies and measures of success.
* Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility and available resources.
* Align product roadmaps with engineering plans, client budgets and broader transformation objectives.
* Guide strategy for new products, platform modernization and improvements to existing digital experiences.

**Product Discovery and Experience Design**

* Lead discovery engagements and executive workshops to frame problems, validate assumptions and establish priorities.
* Oversee user research, customer journeys, service design, prototyping and usability testing.
* Guide UX/UI teams in creating intuitive, accessible and consistent enterprise experiences.
* Ensure product requirements reflect user needs, business rules, operational workflows and technical constraints.
* Establish effective discovery practices that reduce uncertainty before significant development investment.
* Connect research findings and design decisions to measurable product outcomes.

**Product Execution and Engineering Partnership**

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Delivery and QA to turn product strategy into achievable delivery plans.
* Guide Product Managers and Business Analysts in defining requirements, prioritizing backlogs and establishing acceptance criteria.
* Manage product dependencies and resolve competing priorities across multiple engagements.
* Maintain alignment between stakeholders as requirements, budgets and delivery conditions evolve.
* Support launch planning, adoption and ongoing product improvement.
* Establish feedback loops using product analytics, user research and client input.

**Leadership and Practice Development**

* Build, mentor and retain a strong team of Product Managers, Business Analysts and UX/UI professionals.
* Define roles, career paths, performance expectations and development plans.
* Establish consistent methods, templates and quality standards across product strategy, discovery, business analysis and design.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR on workforce planning, hiring and capability development.
* Balance team capacity across billable client engagements, account development and internal initiatives.
* Develop reusable frameworks and accelerators that improve engagement quality and efficiency.

**Client Partnership and Business Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with client CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CPOs and other senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate executive workshops that create agreement on business problems, product priorities and investment decisions.
* Present recommendations through clear storytelling, supporting analysis and practical implementation plans.
* Partner with Sales and Business Development on discovery, proposals, estimates and client presentations.
* Shape paid and exploratory workshops with clear objectives, scope and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to expand client relationships through product innovation, modernization and improved customer experiences.
* Support thought leadership, industry events and go-to-market initiatives.

* Assess emerging technologies, including AI and Web3 where relevant, against practical business needs and commercial viability.
* Partner with technical leaders to evaluate architecture options, platform choices and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Help clients align technology investments, operating models and Agile delivery practices with their product ambitions.
* Incorporate data, privacy, security and responsible AI considerations into discovery and product planning.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive experience across product management, technology strategy, digital consulting or enterprise application development.
* At least eight years of experience within technology consulting or digital engineering organizations, delivering strategy and product engagements for external clients.
* Demonstrated experience leading Product Managers, Business Analysts and UX/UI professionals.
* Proven success defining product strategies, building roadmaps and guiding enterprise products from discovery through delivery.
* A strong technical foundation, including prior hands-on experience in application or product development and technical product management.
* Experience leading UX/UI workshops, product discovery and user-centred design for enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of web and mobile applications, cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, APIs and enterprise integrations.
* Experience developing business cases, assessing investment options and connecting product decisions to measurable business value.
* Proven ability to facilitate executive workshops and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong consulting skills, including problem framing, structured analysis, presentation development and recommendation delivery.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to create clear executive presentations in PowerPoint.

* Products achieve measurable improvements in adoption, customer experience and business performance.

Title: Project Manager, Airport Systems
Description:
We are hiring a Project Manager with airport experience to deliver EMMA's products at airports, from contract signature to go-live and handover. We expect you to use AI tools for the routine parts of the job, so your time goes on customers, risks and decisions.

EMMA Systems is an airport operations software company. Our products cover the operational database and resource management core, airport collaborative decision making (A-CDM), pre-departure sequencing and turnaround monitoring.

You will work directly with airport project teams, our engineers and consultants, and the founders. EMMA is a startup: the team is small, decisions are fast, and you will see your projects go live at real airports.

The role is based in Doha, Qatar. If you are elsewhere, you would relocate.

* Coordinate EMMA's engineers, consultants and partners across locations and time zones.
* Track actions, risks and issues, and escalate early.
* Use AI tools to draft plans, minutes, status reports and project documents, and to keep them current.
* Hand over cleanly to support after go-live, with documentation the customer can use.
* Feed what you learn at each airport back to product and to the next project.
* Travel to customer airports for the key phases of each project.

**Must have**

* 5+ years managing software or systems implementation projects for external customers, from kick-off to go-live.
* Has managed scope, schedule, budget and risk on several projects at once.
* Has run steering committees and handled difficult customer conversations.
* Writes clear plans, reports and minutes.
* Airport experience (required): has worked for an airport operator, or has delivered systems or projects on site at airports for a supplier or integrator.
* Understands airport operations: the turnaround, stand and gate allocation, and how the operator, airlines, handlers and air traffic control work together.
* Comfortable in an airport operations control centre and with operational users.
* Uses AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT every day in project work, and can show examples.

* Writes and speaks clearly in English.
* A self-starter who has worked in a startup or a small team, and does not wait to be told what to do.

* Experience on the airline, ground handling or air navigation side as well.

Title: Integrated Command & Control Center (ICCC) & Digital Twin (DT) Product Manager
Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Description:
**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai.

Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions.

This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects.

**What You'll Deliver & Own**

**Team and execution leadership**

* Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives.
* Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows.
* Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues.
* Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments.
* Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio.

**Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance**

* Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation.
* Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed.
* Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards.
* Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions.
* Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions.

**Project delivery, construction and handover**

* Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges.
* Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management.
* Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M.
* Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities.

**What You Must Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management.
* A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects.
* Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection.
* Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes.
* Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues.
* Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

**Strong Advantage**

* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).
* Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER.
* Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
* Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review.
* You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive.
* You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people.
* You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement.
* You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio.

**Why Join Us?**

You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions.

The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams.

**About Yellow Door Energy**

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.

Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

**Apply Now!**

If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.**

The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.

* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.

* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
