Title: Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.

As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.

As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.

* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.

* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.

* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.  

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**

Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
* Ensure program delivery complies with applicable Project Management Department, PMO, SDLC, risk and control requirements

**Technology Delivery and Release Oversight**

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.  

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

Essential

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable

**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**

The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.

**Our Benefits**

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

Citco recognizes diversity as a source of organizational pride and strength. Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities, and accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Pay: $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On-site parking
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Application question(s):

* How many years of work experience do you have with IT Strategy?
* Have you built or significantly developed an IT, business technology, technology governance, or technology enablement function or process from the ground up?
* Do you have hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO, permissions, branch protection or repository governance?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments, including identity, MFA, endpoint management, and security?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering or supporting platforms such as Supabase, PostgreSQL, Netlify, Vercel, or similar technologies?

Experience:

* IT: 7 years (required)
* DevOps: 3 years (required)
* Microsoft Platform: 3 years (required)

Job Functions
  
  
**The Position**
The IT Services Director performs complex professional work in the planning, organizing, and coordinating of the development, implementation, and maintenance of the City’s electronic data processing, management information systems, and related operations. The Director provides leadership, direction, and advanced professional expertise and oversight to the Department and employees responsible for coordination of the IT services for the City and is responsible for short- and long-range planning of the City’s technical infrastructure to ensure that it supports current and future business needs.
  
  
The complete classification description for the Director of Information Technology Services position can be viewed here.
  
  
**The Department**
The Information Technology Services Department consists of 16.67 FTE, including the Director. The department has four groups, IT Central Support Services, Business Systems and Transformation Services, Network Operations and Security Services, and GIS and Data Services. IT Central Support Services provides City staff with Tier I and Tier II technical support of hardware, software, and systems. Business Systems and Transformation Services is responsible for maintaining business systems throughout their full lifecycle – requirements, procurement, implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Network Operations and Security Services is responsible for network, server, and telecommunication infrastructure as well as physical and cybersecurity, including identity management, emails, files, firewalls, and desktop and server patching. GIS and Data Services is tasked with creating, implementing, and maintaining geographic information data standards and enterprise GIS systems.
  
  
**Duties**
The department has a budget of $3.3 million. In addition to its regular operational duties, some of the Department’s current projects include:
  
  

* Support of the new City Hall construction at 12 South Summit Avenue.
* Implementation of a Rubrik-based backup and disaster recovery system.
* Creation of comprehensive IT policies and procedures.
* Replacement of the City’s phone system.
* Implementation of resilient WAN connections at major facilities.
* Evaluation and implementation of Artificial Intelligence technologies.
* Implementation activities surrounding major Public Works GIS initiatives.
* Selection and implementation of a centralized data warehouse with analytical services and artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Selection and implementation of a Constituent Relationship Management system.
* Implementation of a new HRIS, Payroll and Time and Attendance system.
* Implementation of a comprehensive ITSM/ITAM system.
* Replacement of the meeting management system.
* Supporting the City’s upcoming 2027 elections.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or related field.
* At least 10 years of experience managing information technology systems, the majority of which shall have been in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Valid driver's license.

**Desired/Preferred Qualifications**

* Local government experience is desired; municipal government experience is strongly preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification; and/or
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)/Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); and/or
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Service Management (ITSM) certification; and/or
* Certified Geographic Information System Professional (GISP).

**The Successful Candidate**
The ideal candidate for the Director of Information Technology Services position is a proficient, accomplished and forward-thinking public sector leader who is passionate about transforming local government through technology and is dedicated to public service. This individual is a strategic thinker who can translate big-picture goals into actionable plans, while also possessing the hands-on practical expertise to ensure high-quality service delivery, technological security, and operational effectiveness. The ideal candidate demonstrates intellectual humility and curiosity, values the expertise and institutional knowledge of experienced staff, and fosters meaningful collaboration within the department and across the organization while building strong relationships with elected officials, community members, and regional partners. They will possess the ability to navigate sensitive issues and competing interests with diplomacy, fairness, and discretion.
  
  
An exceptional communicator and listener, the successful candidate understands the value of inclusive engagement, transparency, and trust-building. They are committed to cultivating a positive organizational culture, empowering and developing staff through coaching, recognizing collective accomplishments, and managing performance in a constructive, accountability-oriented manner. This person must be comfortable with ambiguity and change, capable of championing innovation while maintaining reliable IT operations, and skilled in balancing strategic priorities with available resources and long-term operational sustainability. With a solid understanding of information technology operations, public administration, municipal finance, and municipal operations, the ideal Director of Information Technology Services brings both a visionary mindset and an engaged leadership style. They are technically proficient and grounded in values of equity, integrity, and professionalism, and thrive in an evolving, team-oriented environment where collaboration, creativity, and service excellence are expected and rewarded.

Title: Corporate Transformation Manager
Description:
At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.
  
  
Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management, our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best-in-class customer experience.
  
  
Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.
  
  
Check us out on the web!
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Corporate Transformation Manager to join our growing team! In this role, you will accelerate value creation from existing initiatives via strategic problem-solving to remove roadblocks/establish enablers and define incremental initiatives to bridge value gap.
  
  
**As a Corporate Transformation Manager, your duties and responsibilities will include:**

* Initiative accelerants

+ Identify gaps between existing transformation initiatives and budget / long-range plan targets
+ Diagnose major roadblocks to initiatives, find root causes and design plans to address

+ Partner with initiative managers to understand success factors and critical enablers

* Incremental Initiatives

+ Identify opportunities, over and above current initiatives, to realize and surpass annual targets
+ Validate, quantify, and define implementation plan before handing over execution to an initiative lead

* Program strategic review

+ Risk assessment of the overall value creation plan
+ Proactively identify ways to continuously improve existing transformation program and to mitigate its risks

* Executive communication

+ Prepare comprehensive reports in coordination with the rest of the Transformation team and presentations summarizing the status of transformation initiatives, including key milestones, achievements, and challenges.
+ Present findings to senior leadership and stakeholders, providing actionable insights and recommendations for improvement.

**Qualifications**
**WHAT IT TAKES TO CATCH OUR EYE:**

+ 5+ years of experience in a top tier strategy consulting firm
+ 8+ years of relevant experience and career progression

* Structured problem solving & analytical skills

+ Ability to navigate ambiguous problem contexts and identify relevant issues/resolutions through a structured process
+ Excellent quantitative skills and data driven decision making capabilities

* Strong executive communication / presence

+ Ability to clearly articulate insights (verbal & written)

* Stakeholder Management

+ Proven experience in complex programmatic change leadership, with the ability to run multiple transformational programs simultaneously and deliver high-quality results and business value

* Unwavering focus on results while creating strong relationships

+ Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously

**BONUS POINTS FOR:**

* Telecom experience

+ Understands wireline telco financials and drivers
+ Familiar with telco operations and associated KPIs
+ Understanding of US fiber market

Brightspeed offers a comprehensive benefit program, including competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; an employee assistance program; a 401K plan with company match and a host of voluntary benefits.

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

Title: Director Operations (Hospital)
Description:
**Director Operations (Hospital) | Dubai, UAE**

**About Us**

Our client is a new premium tertiary hospital in Dubai Healthcare City, opening in 2027. Backed by Scope Investment, it is being developed as an academic medical centre for the region. Advanced gastroenterology is its flagship programme, supported by a growing range of specialist services and centres of excellence. The hospital combines the latest medical technology with an academic approach to care, teaching and research, in a state-of-the-art building with premium design and a seamless digital patient journey. Care is physician-led and organised around the patient, and the hospital is designed to meet JCI standards from day one. Joining us now means helping to shape a new hospital from the ground up and building your career in an academic setting, with teaching, research, and fellowship opportunities alongside clinical practice.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an accomplished hospital operations leader with strong UAE healthcare experience to lead operational readiness, commissioning, service delivery, and continuous improvement as the hospital progresses towards opening and full 24/7 operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead hospital commissioning, phased activation, go-live and post-opening operational stabilisation
* Oversee day-to-day clinical support, administrative and non-clinical operations
* Establish operational governance, process ownership, KPIs, SLAs and executive performance reporting
* Optimize patient flow, capacity, productivity, service quality and resource utilisation.
* Develop the Operations Command Centre and real-time operational management capability
* Drive operational excellence, process improvement and measurable benefits realisation
* Lead operational requirements for HIS implementation, digitalisation, automation and responsible AI adoption
* Ensure operational compliance and readiness for DHA licensing, JCI accreditation, audits and patient-safety requirements
* Partner with Finance and clinical leaders on budgets, cost optimisation, service-line growth and revenue performance
* Oversee patient experience, support services, vendor performance, business continuity and emergency preparedness
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing Operations team for the new hospital

**Ideal Candidate**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in hospital operations, operational excellence or healthcare transformation, preferably in Dubai or the wider UAE.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience in hospital operations or operational transformation.
* Strong UAE hospital experience with sound knowledge of DHA requirements and JCI standards
* Hands-on involvement in commissioning, opening, expanding or transforming a hospital
* Demonstrated success in patient flow, capacity planning, workforce productivity, cost optimisation and service improvement
* Experience with HIS implementation, performance dashboards, digital workflows, automation or AI-enabled operations
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration or a related field is preferred

If you are a healthcare operations leader who would like to shape the operating model of a new hospital from the ground up, we would be pleased to hear from you.

**Ideal Candidate**

**We are particularly interested in hospital operations leaders who have successfully contributed to commissioning or opening a new hospital in the UAE and can establish robust operational systems, governance and performance controls from the ground up.**

Candidates should demonstrate direct responsibility for operational readiness, patient flow, process improvement, digital enablement and multidisciplinary service delivery. This is an opportunity to do more than manage daily operations. You will help shape the operational foundation, culture, and patient journey of a new academic hospital from commissioning through full 24/7 operations.

**Please note: This position requires extensive hospital operations and commissioning experience. Applicants without relevant healthcare and hospital experience will not be considered.**

Title: Project Engineering Manager, Staff
Industry: Semiconductor Manufacturing, Software Development, and Computer Hardware Manufacturing
Description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own and maintain the integrated schedule and critical path across multiple Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams, from project kickoff and architecture through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness. Model dependency chains deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips and pull-ins, distinguish paths with float from those without it, and update the plan weekly using current engineering data.
* Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing inputs from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams into a single view of program health, emerging concerns, and required actions.
* Track verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Monitor feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive a recovery plan before downstream milestones or customer commitments are affected.
* Analyze schedule scenarios and coordinate recovery plans. Work with engineering leads to understand technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float; quantify the impact of changes; develop practical options; and track agreed recovery actions to closure.
* Manage external partner and customer dependencies by owning delivery calendars, tracking execution plans and acceptance criteria, aligning technical dependencies, and supporting schedule negotiations with a clear understanding of downstream technical, commercial, and resource impacts.
* Lead cross-functional risk, issue, and decision management. Convert technical uncertainty into clear options, owners, dates, and decision points. Ensure risks, assumptions, and trade-offs are visible early and resolved at the appropriate level.
* Provide concise project insight to executives and customers. Distill complex engineering information into evidence-based updates that distinguish signal from noise, quantify schedule and delivery impact, and clearly identify the actions or decisions needed.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification-convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug-closure velocity has slowed. You bring the DV lead and RTL owner together for a focused sync, clarify the cause, and align on a recovery plan before the weekly project review.
  
  
In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects an internal delivery shift, quantify the downstream impact on release timing and customer commitments, and identify the decisions needed to protect the plan. Later, you follow-up with R&D on the strategy to take to resolve the issue, then finish the day preparing a concise executive summary and following up on owners and due dates from the project review.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong working knowledge of semiconductor development lifecycles and the relationships among architecture, RTL, verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, software, infrastructure, and productization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with meaningful dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, and the downstream effects of schedule changes.
* Experience using engineering evidence such as feature readiness, bug trends, regression results, coverage, design closure, and delivery health to assess schedule risk and drive corrective action.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical and program information, develop practical options, and recommend a course of action.
* Strong communication and influence skills, including the ability to gain cooperation across engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners and to present crisp status and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Familiarity with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Who You Are
  
  
This is not a status-reporting role. You will connect a broad set of engineering workstreams into a coherent, dependency-driven plan, identify the real critical path week to week, and drive the cross-functional actions and decisions that keep complex Memory Interface IP projects on track. The work spans concurrent development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, customers, external partners, and development infrastructure.
  
  
Working with general direction, you will apply strong semiconductor-development knowledge and program-management judgment to analyze issues, recommend practical solutions, and gain cooperation across teams. Success requires attention to engineering detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn complex technical inputs into clear priorities, ownership, and delivery commitments.
  
  
The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. We work at the intersection of architecture, analog and mixed-signal design, RTL, verification, physical design, software, infrastructure, and customer deployment. The programs are technically complex, globally distributed, and tightly connected to customer and business commitments.
  
  
We value people who combine advanced technical judgment with clear communication, disciplined execution, and the willingness to work through details without losing sight of the broader outcome. In this role, you will help shape how complex semiconductor programs are planned and delivered, strengthen execution practices across teams, and work alongside talented engineers solving consequential problems at scale.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Should you require an accommodation, please contact hr-help-canada@synopsys.com.

Every day, we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses, connecting people to the energy they need for their lives. To succeed, we must anticipate customer needs, reduce energy delivery costs, and pioneer flexible energy systems. This requires delivering on our promises and seeking opportunities for growth.

In IT and Digital, we collaborate closely with the diverse energy businesses within the National Grid group, revolutionizing operations through technology. Embracing modern methodologies and digital mindsets, we drive efficiency and bring new capabilities to internal and external customers as we lead the charge toward a carbon-free future.

Our work is critical, as National Grid powers millions of homes and businesses across the UK and US, and the technology we employ is vital to this task. The successful applicant for this position will play a crucial role in our mission, supported by our multicultural, customer-centric global team, with opportunities for professional development.

**National Grid is hiring a Head of US Operational Technology role which operates under a hybrid working model and is open to candidates based at our Waltham, MA, Syracuse, NY, and Brooklyn, NY.**

**This is a hybrid role. Employees are expected to work from their assigned office or another approved work location outside the home at least three days per week. Additional in-person attendance may be required based on role, team, and business needs.**

### **Job Purpose**

The Head of U.S. Operational Technology (OT) is a senior leadership role accountable for the safe, reliable, resilient, secure and supportable operation of the technology environments that underpin real-time electric transmission, electric distribution and gas distribution operations across Massachusetts and New York. The role reports to the VP, Head of IT&D Electric and works in close partnership with Electric and Gas Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Architecture, Regulatory, Capital Delivery and other enterprise technology leaders.

The role leads a multidisciplinary organization responsible for 24x7 operational support and lifecycle stewardship of OT applications and infrastructure. The scope includes Energy Management Systems (EMS), Gas Management System (GMS), Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), SCADA-related capabilities and the supporting network, compute, storage, database, integration and recovery environments. It also includes designated technology supporting LNG operations, physical security systems, substation controllers and substation access points.

You’ll join an established team, building on its existing strengths to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders, you’ll help shape priorities, improve ways of working, and support the team’s continued development and success.

The Head of OT leads directors responsible for application and infrastructure domains and is a key partner to control center, operations, regulatory and executive stakeholders. The role requires experienced, visible leadership during significant events; disciplined governance; strong technical judgment; and the ability to convert technical risk into clear business decisions.

### **Key Accountabilities**

**Safe, Reliable and Resilient Operations**

* Own the availability, resilience, performance, and recoverability of the OT estate.
* Establish clear 24x7 operational accountability, escalation, and decision-making.
* Lead technology response to major incidents and operational events.
* Maintain and test business continuity, disaster recovery, and recovery capabilities.
* Ensure readiness for storms, grid emergencies, outages, and critical operational events.
* Drive continuous improvement through incident analysis and root-cause elimination.

**Cybersecurity, Safety, Compliance and Risk**

* Ensure readiness and compliance with applicable regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.
* Embed safety, cyber, compliance, and risk considerations into technology decisions.
* Maintain auditable controls, remediation plans, and risk management processes.
* Provide transparent reporting on operational, technology, and compliance risks.
* Support regulatory filings, rate cases, and investment planning.

**Technology Strategy and Lifecycle Stewardship**

* Own OT technology roadmaps aligned to business, regulatory, and investment priorities.
* Proactively manage technology obsolescence and lifecycle risk.
* Drive risk-based management of patching, upgrades, vulnerabilities, capacity, and technical debt.
* Establish standards for integration, automation, observability, and platform management.
* Enable trusted operational data, analytics, and AI capabilities.

**Portfolio Prioritization and Investment Leadership**

* Own OT demand, capacity, and prioritization across operations and capital programs.
* Lead transparent prioritization and resource trade-off decisions.
* Maintain credible operational and capital forecasts.
* Translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure effective governance, intake, and decision-making processes.

**Enabling Capital Delivery and Operational Acceptance**

* Align OT resources to the highest-priority initiatives.
* Represent operational requirements throughout delivery and implementation.
* Ensure operational readiness before service acceptance.
* Identify and manage cross-program dependencies and risks.
* Enable smooth transition from project delivery to steady-state operations.

**Team Leadership, Capability and Culture**

* Lead and develop senior leaders across OT applications and infrastructure.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish role clarity across internal teams, partners, and suppliers.
* Build workforce capability, succession plans, and organizational resilience.
* Ensure teams are trained and prepared to meet operational and compliance obligations.
* Strengthen collaboration across OT, IT&D, Operations, Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Capital Delivery.

**Stakeholder, Executive and Vendor Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships with operational and business leaders.
* Provide clear, data-driven reporting to executives and governance forums.
* Lead strategic supplier performance, accountability, and risk management.
* Challenge decisions that increase operational risk or reduce delivery credibility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and technology decisions.

### **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated accountability for mission-critical services, operational risk, incident management, and service performance.
* Deep expertise in one or more OT domains (EMS, ADMS, DERMS, GMS, SCADA, OMS) with the ability to lead across a broader technology landscape.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning applications, infrastructure, networks, integration, databases, and operational support.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, resilience, and regulatory frameworks, including NERC CIP and TSA requirements.

* Experience managing strategic vendors, managed services, and system integrators.
* Strong financial, workforce, and portfolio management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent relevant experience.

Title: Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations
Description:
**We're Hiring**

**Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations**

*Re-engineer a global payroll operation: platform-led, offshore-first, automated, advisory.*

**Department:**
Payroll & SaaS

**Reports To:**
Initially the Group CEO; transitioning to the Business Unit Managing Director

**Location:**
Dubai, UAE (onsite preferred); hybrid considered for the right candidate. Travel required.

**About Mercans**

Mercans is a global workforce solutions company. Through technology-led payroll and SaaS services, we help organizations pay and manage their people across borders — compliantly and at scale. We are re-engineering how our global payroll operation runs, and this role leads that transformation.

**The Opportunity**

**This is a hands-on transformation role, not a back-office management one.**
We are looking for a leader to re-engineer Mercans' managed-payroll operation into a country-agnostic, offshore-first, product-led model — one where country knowledge lives in the platform and a central compliance center of excellence rather than in individuals, where automation and AI remove manual work, and where customers own and control their data and execution through self-service. The goal is a standardized run-cycle where any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, and an operation that partners with clients strategically rather than just processing their payroll.

**This is a hands-on, grass-roots role.**
You will learn the product deeply, get close to clients and the operation, resolve issues at the grass-root level, and lead by doing rather than delegating. You will report initially to the Group CEO and, in due course, to the Business Unit Managing Director.

**What You'll Own**

Your mission is to deliver a new operating model. You will:

1. **Build a country-agnostic operating model**
   — codify country rules and knowledge into the platform and a central compliance center of excellence, with one standardized run-cycle and no single-expert dependency.
2. **Build an offshore-first, fungible workforce**
   — cross-trained and “2-deep” in every country, delivering high productivity at scale.
3. **Put customers in control**
   — self-service and data ownership through the product, and a strategic, advisory relationship instead of support ping-pong.
4. **Automate relentlessly**
   — automate manual and country-variable steps, deploy AI as a knowledge layer, and use anomaly detection for visibility and quality.
5. **Run a leaner, focused delivery core**
   with disciplined quality and performance governance.
6. **Migrate all clients onto a single platform**
   to eliminate manual processes and enable people to move freely between clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Country-Agnostic, Platform-Led Operating Model**

* Relocate country knowledge out of individuals into the platform (codified rules, wage-type catalogs, formulas) and a central compliance center of excellence.
* Establish one standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle so any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, eliminating single-expert dependency.
* Migrate all clients onto a single platform to remove manual processes and enable free movement of people between clients.

**Offshore-First, Fungible Workforce**

* Make offshore the primary delivery model; cross-train so no client depends on a single person and every country is “2-deep.”
* Drive consultant productivity toward best-in-class levels at scale.

**Customer Experience, Self-Service & Data Ownership**

* Give customers ownership and control of their data, timelines, and execution through self-service.
* Shift client engagement from tactical execution to a strategic, advisory partnership, and drive changes to customer data toward zero for compliance.

**Automation & AI**

* Automate every manual and country-variable step (statutory reports, integrations, bank files, and more) using a deliberate map → automate → internalize approach.
* Deploy AI as an on-demand knowledge layer and anomaly-detection tooling for visibility and quality.

**Scope, Quality & Performance Governance**

* Run a leaner, focused managed-payroll delivery core with clear scope discipline.
* Stand up a business-assurance / QA function with process audits, SLA monitoring, a regional RAG on stability, scalability, and resilience, and a disciplined review, coaching, and appraisal cadence.

**How You'll Work — Hands-On & Grass-Roots**

* Learn the product and the operation first-hand, stay close to clients, and resolve issues at root cause rather than delegating.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Hands-on and grass-roots by nature —**
  you learn the product deeply, get close to clients and operations, and resolve issues at root-cause level rather than delegating.
* **Operating-model transformation —**
  proven design and delivery of a standardized, offshore-first, platform-led payroll/operations model that removes country-knowledge and single-expert dependency.
* **Automation and AI expertise —**
  process standardization, product adoption, automation, and applied AI (including agentic AI) to eliminate manual work.
* **A customer-advisory and self-service orientation —**
  you move clients to self-service and strategic partnership, delivering an unparalleled client experience.
* **Operations leadership at scale —**
  10+ years in global payroll outsourcing or SaaS operations, including multi-regional and offshore delivery leadership.
* **Technology and compliance fluency —**
  deep understanding of payroll/SaaS platforms, config-driven operations, integrations, and multi-country payroll compliance.
* **Leadership and resilience —**
  proven ability to coach teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and stay composed under pressure.
* **Education —**
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 12–18 months, success means:

* A standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle is live — any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, with no single-expert dependency.
* Delivery is offshore-first and “2-deep,” with strong consultant productivity.
* Customers self-serve and own their data, and the relationship is strategic and advisory — with excellent CSAT and retention.
* Manual and country-variable steps are automated, and clients are migrated onto a single platform.
* The delivery core is leaner and well-governed, with clean compliance and strong quality assurance.

**Why Mercans**

* Lead a genuine transformation of a global operation at the center of how the world pays its people.
* A real mandate to re-engineer the model — this is a role for a builder, not a caretaker.
* A global, fast-moving, technology-led environment with a direct line to senior leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned to the seniority and impact of the role.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please submit your CV and a short note outlining an operation you have transformed through the Mercans careers portal. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

*Mercans is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.*

Title: Senior Information Systems Manager
Description:
### **About Us**

For over 90 years, Healthcare & Municipal Employees' Credit Union (HMECU) has proudly served healthcare, municipal, fire, and police communities across Ontario. We are committed to helping our members achieve financial wellbeing through trusted advice, exceptional service, and meaningful relationships.

At HMECU, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our purpose — **We care for the financial needs and wellbeing of our members so you can focus on what matters most** — we are building a culture focused on growth, innovation, accountability, and member impact.

### **Position Summary**

The Senior Information Systems Manager is HMECU’s senior technical authority, accountable for the effective operation, security, reliability and continuous improvement of the Credit Union’s information technology and information systems. Reporting to the Chief Operations & Digital Officer (CODO), the Manager provides expert technical leadership, proactively recommends technology strategy and priorities, and develops and executes an annual IT work plan and longer-term roadmap aligned with organizational objectives and regulatory obligations.

In HMECU’s lean operating environment, this is both a leadership and hands-on delivery role. The Manager is expected to independently identify needs and risks, develop practical plans, carry out technical and administrative work, coordinate external service providers where appropriate, and lead initiatives through implementation, documentation, testing, adoption and ongoing monitoring. The role serves as a key technical advisor and contributor across the organization.

  

### **Job Responsibilities**

### **Technology Leadership, Planning and Delivery**

* Act as HMECU's senior technical subject-matter expert; assess technology needs and recommend practical, secure and cost-effective solutions.
* Develop and execute an annual IT work plan and multi-year technology roadmap addressing system lifecycles, security, compliance, audits, projects and continuous improvement.
* Own initiatives from requirements and planning through implementation, testing, documentation, adoption and post-implementation review.
* Anticipate technology, regulatory and operational requirements and proactively recommend priorities, solutions, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Partner with business leaders and the Senior Business Analyst to translate business requirements into sustainable systems, process improvements, integrations and data solutions.

### **Information Security, Risk and Audit Readiness**

* Serve as HMECU’s Information Security Manager unless otherwise designated, fulfilling responsibilities assigned under HMECU's Information Security Policy and related standards.
* Translate security policies, technical standards and regulatory requirements into practical controls, procedures and implementation plans.
* Implement and verify security controls, including access management, authentication, endpoint and network protection, vulnerability management, patching and secure configuration.
* Maintain audit and regulatory review readiness, including evidence, gap assessments, remediation plans and reporting.
* Act as the first-line operational owner of technology and information security risks: identify and assess exposures, implement and monitor controls, maintain risk and remediation records, report control effectiveness and support independent review and challenge by risk management and internal audit.
* Develop, maintain and regularly test IT disaster recovery and incident response procedures aligned with HMECU’s broader business continuity framework.
* Ensure timely identification, assessment, documentation and escalation of material IT incidents; support authorized management in meeting applicable regulatory notification requirements, conducting post-incident reviews and completing corrective actions.

### **IT Operations, Infrastructure and Service Delivery**

* Ensure dependable daily operation, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting and support of HMECU’s infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, integrations and core technology services; perform work directly when needed.
* Manage service requests, incidents, system changes, access administration and technical documentation, ensuring timely follow-through and communication.
* Administer or oversee user provisioning, access changes, periodic access reviews and deprovisioning across relevant systems, with appropriate approvals and segregation of duties.
* Lead IT change management processes, including change assessment, approvals, testing, implementation, rollback planning and records.
* Maintain technology asset inventories, lifecycle and replacement plans, licensing, backups and operational procedures.
* Oversee HMECU’s ATM technology, including availability, technical support, vendor coordination, upgrades, security and operational continuity.

### **Projects, Emerging Technology and Artificial Intelligence**

* Lead the technical assessment, design, implementation and integration of technology projects, including coordination of vendors, testing, conversion, deployment and operational handover.
* Proactively assess emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, and recommend suitable use cases, solutions and implementation approaches.
* Lead technical enablement and ongoing management of approved AI tools and other emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with HMECU’s AI Policy, privacy and information security requirements, and supporting employee adoption and training in partnership with business owners.

### **Vendor, Financial and Resource Management**

* Own the operational performance and delivery of HMECU’s managed IT service provider and assigned technology vendors, including service expectations, issue escalation, follow-up and verification of completed work.
* Contribute technical expertise and evidence to third-party risk assessments, contract reviews, procurement decisions, renewals and technology dependencies; track required vendor actions.
* Develop, manage and monitor the IT operating and capital budgets; forecast technology spending, renewals and project costs, identify efficiencies and explain variances and investment needs.
* Plan and prioritize available resources realistically, personally undertaking technical, administrative and implementation work where no internal IT resource is available.

### **Governance, Privacy and Organizational Collaboration**

* Participate as a member of HMECU’s Privacy Committee, providing technical advice, supporting privacy risk assessments, and implementing assigned technology and security actions in coordination with the designated Privacy Officer.
* Ensure technology practices and deliverables support applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and approved governance frameworks; provide accurate, timely reporting and recommendations to management and committees.
* Work constructively with staff and leaders across HMECU to resolve issues, communicate technology changes, support training and promote responsible use of information systems.

### **Minimum Requirements**

* 8–10 years of relevant information technology experience, preferably including at least 3 years managing an IT function or comparable end-to-end technical accountability.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are assets.
* Demonstrated hands-on capability across IT operations, infrastructure, security controls, incident management, system administration and vendor-supported environments.
* Experience translating policies, standards, audit findings and technical requirements into implemented procedures, controls, evidence and completed remediation.
* Strong planning, prioritization, problem-solving, project delivery and communication skills, including the ability to present clear recommendations, alternatives, risks and progress to management.
* Experience in a regulated financial services environment, IT audit, security frameworks, privacy or emerging technology/AI governance is an asset.
* SQL skills and related technical certifications are assets.

Title: Director, Business Technology & Transformation
Description:
North America Construction (1993) Ltd. – NAC Constructors Ltd. (NAC) is well known for our expertise in water and wastewater construction across Canada. Our self-performing team of almost 500 skilled professionals and experts in trades and engineering, comprehensively handles projects, from conceptualization to delivery. We also have extensive experience in fields such as civil, structural, process mechanical, building mechanical, electrical and instrumentation work. At NAC, our priority is to maintain the highest level of quality and safety. The depth of our resources is evident in the variety of projects we construct; from water filtration to wastewater treatment; dams to ethanol; we build it all….and more!

Bring your construction industry knowledge and technology leadership experience to NAC, where you’ll have the opportunity to shape our technology strategy, modernize business systems, and drive meaningful business transformation.

North America Construction (NAC) is looking for a business-minded technology leader who understands the demands of a construction or project-based environment and can translate technology into practical business improvements.

Reporting to the VP, Corporate Services, you will lead NAC’s technology strategy, manage a small internal technology team, and oversee external providers. Working closely with executive leadership and teams across finance, operations, estimating, HR, equipment, and projects, you will improve business systems, decision-making, productivity, and the employee experience.

### **Position Responsibilities:**

**Technology Strategy & Governance**

* Maintain a technology and transformation roadmap aligned with corporate priorities and business objectives.
* Establish technology governance, standards, policies and decision-making processes.
* Manage budgets and investment plans, assess emerging technologies, and develop and present business cases to executive leadership.

**Enterprise Applications**

* Provide strategic direction for NAC’s enterprise applications, including ERP platforms, Jonas Construction Software, Procore, Primavera P6, Concur, HR systems, equipment and fleet systems, and future applications.
* Lead or oversee enterprise system implementations, integrations, modernization and enhancements, including requirements definition, vendor management, implementation planning, change management and user adoption. Ensure systems are effectively integrated, aligned with business processes, and support operational efficiency and NAC's evolving business needs.

**Data & Analytics**

* Lead data governance, stewardship, business intelligence and reporting capabilities, including Power BI, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs, and data warehouse and reporting architecture.
* Ensure teams have access to reliable, timely and actionable information to support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

**Digital Workplace, Automation & AI**

* Lead digital workplace strategy, governance, and adoption across Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Platform, and Copilot.
* Lead the planning, governance and adoption of AI and emerging technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation, knowledge management and collaboration tools. Identify opportunities to improve productivity and business efficiency through effective implementation, change management and employee adoption.

**Business Transformation & Process Improvement**

* Partner with business leaders to identify, prioritize and lead company-wide transformation initiatives and technology-enabled process improvements.
* Lead initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce manual and administrative effort, and improve productivity and operational effectiveness. Work with business leaders to establish, measure, and evaluate the benefits and outcomes of these initiatives.

**Technology Operations, Cybersecurity & Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic oversight of technology operations, infrastructure planning, managed service providers, service levels, cybersecurity, technology risk, business continuity and disaster recovery. Ensure technology services are secure, reliable and aligned with business needs and NAC's growth.
* Lead and manage NAC's internal technology team, establishing priorities, delegating responsibilities, coaching and developing team members, and ensuring effective coordination with external service providers.
* Ensure NAC has the appropriate resources, expertise, governance and controls to support its technology environment. Maintain overall accountability for technology performance, service delivery, operational reliability and risk management, whether delivered internally or through external providers.

### **Qualifications:**

* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications in project management, business analysis, IT service management, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture or organizational change management are considered assets.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership, business systems, enterprise applications, digital transformation or business technology, with increasing responsibility for strategy, delivery and organizational outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology functions, internal teams, external service providers and enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Experience in construction, engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing or other project-based organizations strongly preferred.
* Proven experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks and investment plans aligned with business objectives.
* Demonstrated experience leading ERP implementations, enterprise application modernization, system integrations and business systems optimization.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, data management, business intelligence, analytics and executive reporting.
* Experience leading enterprise business intelligence, data visualization and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Domo or comparable solutions. Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs and data governance practices that support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.
* Demonstrated success leading technology-enabled business transformation, process improvement and organizational change initiatives, with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Experience overseeing IT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Familiarity with AI, automation, Microsoft Copilot and emerging technologies, including their practical business applications, governance considerations and organizational adoption.
* Strong business acumen and financial awareness, with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments and assess their business value.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management and change leadership skills, including the ability to translate complex technology concepts into practical business recommendations and outcomes.

**By the end of your first 24 months, you will have:**

* Established and implemented a clear enterprise technology and business transformation roadmap aligned with NAC's corporate priorities.
* Strengthened technology governance, investment planning and executive decision-making, while building strong business-wide relationships.
* Improved the effectiveness, integration and adoption of key enterprise applications and advanced the modernization of NAC's business systems.
* Expanded adoption of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform and Copilot, supported by appropriate governance and employee adoption.
* Strengthened company-wide reporting, analytics, data governance and executive visibility into business performance.
* Identified and delivered meaningful improvements through automation, workflow redesign and technology-enabled process transformation.
* Strengthened cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery and overall operational reliability.
* Established a well-managed technology function with clear accountability, effective external partnerships and the capabilities required to support NAC's future growth.

  
  

**NAC Offers:**

* Competitive compensation
* Opportunities for career growth, development and advancement, including financial assistance
* Comprehensive benefit plan (dental, vision, health, etc.)
* Employee & Family Assistance Program
* Excellent company matched pension plan
* Registered Retirement Savings Plans
* Additional time off between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Community involvement opportunities
* Friendly working environment
* Numerous team activities and various company events
